### P250 - the diffusion filters as a physical model (owner, 2026-10-18: «Посмотри как симуляция сделана ... и исправь у нас»)
- Before: the light above a knee spread by a fixed six-level Gaussian PSF, plus a separate lift and veil - a threshold edge,
  a look that changed with the frame's level, and no colour structure in the halo.
- DONE 2026-10-18: DiffusionModel - a share p of all the light (from the filter grade: our strength 0.5 = grade 1/2) spread by
  the filter's PSF, energy kept: out = (1 - p) E + p (K * E). K = core + halo + bloom, each a geometric range of 2D
  exponentials (the bloom with a power-law tail); sizes in micrometres of a 36 mm frame (the same share of the frame at any
  resolution); the halo tinted by moving warm light to its rim and cool light to its core without adding energy. Families:
  Glimmerglass, Black Pro-Mist, Pearlescent, CineBloom, Fog, Double Fog. Fine controls: «Ореол» the halo's share, «Радиус» the
  size, «Дымка» the bloom's share, «Тон свечения» the warmth. On the GPU / CPU the PSF is a sum of the image's own pyramid
  levels (to ~2 px) with per-channel non-negative weights fitted to its encircled energy (photo: gaussdown + B-spline widths;
  viewfinder: the mip pyramid's); Glimmerglass keeps its short star, Pearlescent its pastel; no exposure dependence left.
- Tests: DiffusionModelTest (grade table, warm halo energy, fit within 1 % encircled energy, size invariance), LensFiltersTest
  (energy kept exactly, the glow falls off, the controls), LiveLensFilterTest. Phone: OPPO viewfinder / photo, see below.

  the old binnedBlock rule) is merged as always on the sensor grid (no 2x), the worker gets `dngMosaic 1` and writes its merged
  RAW in the sensor's mosaic layout (hybridWriteMergedDng with the colour block: native merge and sub-frame split); ScamProcessor
  saves that DNG alone, uncompressed, whatever the RAW setting says, and ends the shot (no JPEG; notice «сохранён только DNG
  склеенной мозаики»). CPU tier (no merged RAW): the reference frame's mosaic as captured. Every merge tells the worker
  `mosaicRemosaic 1`; PreferenceKeys no longer writes `mosaicRemosaic 0`; dev key `dng_mosaic_as_captured` removed; mosaic page
  rows stay live with the switch off.

### P268 - the 2x2 / 4x4 grid and the highlight artefacts of the mosaic merges (owner, 2026-10-19, X200 Ultra 10:04-10:05 shots + 4 bursts: «нужно исправить сетку на 2x2 4x4 ... особенно она заметна на сверхширике»; 2x crops with ragged clip borders; «нам нужно чтобы таких артефактов не было и без бенто, причём в любом режиме»; «никогда не было фиолетовых засветов»; «С баером тоже не должно быть артефактов»)

- Cause of the grid: the IMX06C (wide cam 4 and main cam 3, sensor mode 3, Quad) has one microlens per 2x2 block: each site
  class's response changes smoothly over the field (wide: -16..+16 % from corner to corner, main ~1.4 % rms), and the merge
  corrected it with ONE gain set per class: a 4 px hatch whose phase flips across the frame (JPEG: period-4 diagonal peaks 170-220x
  the background on the wide, 11x on the main; HP9 tele fine).
- Done (7a998ea4, 12c24b88, local): HybridGainField - the robust estimate also sums its tiles per zone (24 across the longer side),
  a second pass with that field divided out and the strict tile test, each class a cubic of the zone position fitted with Tukey
  weights (scene-biased zones drop out), applied only where it differs from the global set by more than 1 % rms (else the merge is
  bit for bit as before). Applied on the GPU (kHybNatAccess / kHybNatMark natGainAt, binding 19, bilinear between zone centres)
  and in the CPU binning (native and the sub-frame split; per row once for all frames). Tuning mosaicGainField 1, mosaicGainZones 24.
  Replays (OPPO, worker on the owner's bursts): wide grid tiles median 256 -> 20-31, p90 940 -> 72-136; main 22 -> 15, max 1006 -> 332;
  tele 4x Tetra p90 25 -> 10; tele 2x Quad (0.40 %) and every OPPO / synthetic series (<= 0.63 %) unchanged; cost +0.3 s response.
- Done: the mosaic paths' ultrashort check measures on smooth tiles (hybridMeasuredGain smooth): the main 2x burst's three
  ultrashort frames were refused at a MAD of 16.8 % (median 1.2 % from the metadata; hand shake on textured tiles), so no Bento and
  every highlight stayed clipped. Now Bento applies there (mosaicUsSmooth 1; the plain path unchanged).
- Done: a clipped sample is a lower bound in the native mosaic merges (kHybMergeMosaic / Fast, not kHybMergeMain1): a pixel whose
  own sites clipped took the mean of its dark neighbours (G 0.90 -> 0.45 -> 1.00 across a screw head: the dark dots / ragged
  borders of the 2x crops, also without Bento). Now max(unclipped mean, mean with the clipped samples at their clip).
- Done: scamrgb.glsl never makes a censored G end below both R and B (magenta) - G is raised to min(R, B) by its censoring weight.
- Checks: tools/check_gain_field.cpp (smooth field found within 0.65 %, uniform set / gratings / biased zones: no field; in CI),
  check_dng_ceiling, check_highlight_* (scene C: G clipped in the ultrashort under a blue sky), replays md5: plain series identical
  (syn_b1, x7u_1x, hh_1, zip), mosaic series change only near clipped samples (hand: 14403 px, 0.007 max away from clip flags).
- Phone: OPPO 50 MP Quad before / after (31127 / 31128, same scene): magenta highlight pixels 590 -> 186 (> 8), 21 -> 0 (> 16),
  the speckle inside the clipped windows gone. Not yet shot on the X200 Ultra.
- Open (P269): a 12 MP plain Bayer shot on a resting phone (no shifts between frames) keeps orange / blue dashes along slanted bright
  edges, inside the Bento mask where G clipped even in the ultrashort (the Bento colour pass skips any window with a clipped G)
  and outside it (single-frame demosaic false colour).

  bento_research/notes.md): LMC 9.6 / ArkCam v1.23 = replacement (rej *= 1 - mask for every frame but the ultrashort, the
  ultrashort's map = the mask), mask from a ramp 0.98..1 on the base RGB max, binary dilation r 4, Gaussian sigma 1, the ultrashort

### P274 - ISZ does not work on the X300 Ultra (owner, 2026-10-19, log-2026-10-19_2, build 31093: «isz не работает на X300 Ultra ... должен быть доступен просто через реквест vivo.control.forceSensorMode»): done, pushed.
Cause: every ISZ session streamed a plain Bayer at the normal sensor mode index 2 (the result key), «камера не включила ISZ-режим».
vivo.control.forceSensorMode (0x811b0126) is in the camera's android.request.availableSessionKeys (x300u_camera.txt), and the
camera service compares the session keys of every request with the session parameters: a request without the key removes it
and reconfigures the session at the normal mode. We sent it on the session only («no request copy», P214i). Fix:
VivoQcomIsz.sessionBuilt / mirrorRequest - the forceSensorMode of the session parameters (ISZ module or DCG) is repeated on every
request (VendorTagUtils.builderSessionApply); the old trials (BAYER notes) are void (stamp "#req"). Test VivoQcomIszTest
sessionModeIsRepeatedOnEveryRequest; CI list 252 classes / 1533 tests pass. Not device-tested: check «4.8×» / «9.6×» / DCG
on the X300 Ultra (log: «X300 Ultra camera 5 sensor mode: vivo.control.forceSensorMode 5 on the session and on every request»,
«sensor mode index 2 -> 5»).

### P277 - «Гайд и лаборатория»: the settings shown on the owner's own RAW series (owner, 2026-10-19: «гайд как небольшое приложение в котором всё будет полноценно показано ... чтобы в приложение можно было подгрузить например свою Рав серию»; «тогда лучше всё-таки встроить в наше приложение»; «Может мы сделаем отдельный тогл специально для этого раздела?»; «Сохранять будем в /storage/emulated/0/Download/SCAMERA/Lab и разделять по дате и времени по папкам»; «нам нужно чтобы было наглядно видно что и как работает, те же настройки склейки и тд чтобы можно было понять разницу»): done, local commit, not device-tested.
Capture: «Сохранять снимки для лаборатории» (pref_scam_lab_keep; the lab page and Diagnostics) keeps each SHDR shot in
Download/SCAMERA/Lab/yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss (ScamLab): burst.nch = the worker's input copied by the worker's keep-burst marker (the
lab's folder wins over keep_burst), its header's merged-DNG and diagnostics flags cleared at the end of the shot; meta.json = the
post pipeline's Parameters right before the post pipeline (ScamLabParams, reflection over the plain fields + CCT + noise model;
the shot's metadata path needs the live CaptureResult), the worker tuning (settings' part and the burst's own lines apart), every
default preference typed, sizes, lastNormals, and "orient" - how the photo lies over the sensor frame, found by correlating the
worker RGB's luma with the photo (ScamLabOrient, 8 codes); preview.jpg (1600 px, the pipeline output before the zoom / ISZ crops).
An incomplete folder (failed merge, DNG-only shot) is removed. ScamLab.LOCK: a shot's processing and a lab run never overlap.
Replay (ScamLabRun): ScamLabBurst (a ScamTransport from the file: whole = the file's fd mapped by the worker, or a fragment =
a v11 transport of a 32-aligned window of every frame), the job's ScamHybridBurst-only branches now interface methods
(hybrid, rgbHalfTransport, creOff, settingsTuning, burstTuning, keepable); while a side runs PreferenceValue.overlay makes the
default preferences read as the shot's snapshot (+ the tried value for B), so the tuning, the denoise, tone, colour, sharpening
take the side's value. A merge setting (B's tuning differs) merges again; A of a shot and fragment is cached. The fragment gets
its lens-shading map cropped (RawCrop.cropGainMap), its size and final size. PostPipeline.getRotation no longer needs an open camera.
UI (ScamLabFragment, settings root «Гайд и лаборатория»): the shots (thumbnail, device, size, frames, file size; hold to delete),
a shot's page (the photo with the fragment, tap to move it; 1/9, 1/4, whole frame; the groups SHDR photo / sharpening / tone /
merge, style, LUT, lens filters, colour fine), a group's settings with the value at the shot, a value sheet (switch: the other
state; list; slider), and the comparison (LabCompareView): before / after with a draggable border, double tap x3, pinch, a held
magnifier; «Разница ×4»; «Карта кадров» (the worker's effective-frame map of A and B, few frames dark blue -> twice the median
yellow); the times, whether the merge ran again, «A и B совпадают до пикселя» with why; «Другое значение», «Сохранить B в
настройки». Tests ScamLabOrientTest, ScamLabBurstTest, ScamLabParamsTest. Not device-tested: the capture, the replay, the UI.
To check on the phone: switch on, an SHDR shot -> Lab/<date_time> with three files (log «SCAM_LAB: lab shot kept», «photo over
the sensor frame: code N»); the lab page lists it; a merge setting (e.g. a rejection strength) and a processing one (sharpening)
on the 1/9 fragment; the frame map; the fragment lies where it is on the photo.
P277 round 2 (owner, 2026-10-19, screenshots + video): (1) «при любом кропе экспозиция и тон считались по всему кадру» -
LabFrame: the shot's pipeline records the whole frame's statistics (ArkAe stats of every metering mode, the gain clamp's noise
scale, arkLow width, ScamRgb clip levels, the denoise's p50 / p90, the lens-shading term, the lens filter's level and size) in

### P281 - film simulation (owner, 2026-10-19: screenshots of a film-stock / print / format app; «реализуй это у нас, но не копируй один в один, сделай по-своему»; the same settings structure as the LUTs and the filters; the reference is not to be named in the changelogs): done, not device-tested.
Our own model (processing/color/FilmSim, no code or data of the reference: its code is GPL, its data CC BY-SA): the display
colour back to scene light (mid grey 0.18, the tone's shoulder undone, shadow stops x0.62), three film layers exposed through
Gaussian spectral sensitivities over a partition-of-unity spectrum of the sRGB primaries (35 % of the spectral overlap kept: the
masking / DIR correction), a characteristic curve per layer (difference of two softplus terms, mid grey at the stock's mid
density), an interlayer effect on the log-exposure scale that keeps the neutral scale, dye bands with side absorptions on the
base (the negative's orange mask), printing with a 3200 K lamp onto the paper's three narrow sensitivities balanced on mid grey
(print exposure, tone), the paper's curve and dyes, viewed under D65 (CIE 1931 as the Wyman-Sloan-Shirley lobes, XYZ -> sRGB),
paper white as white, a grey balance over the neutral scale; slides and B&W reversal projected, B&W one silver layer. 20 stocks
(Portra 160/400/800, Gold 200, UltraMax 400, Ektar 100, C200, X-TRA 400, Pro 400H, Vision3 50D/250D/500T, E100, Velvia 50,
Provia 100F, Kodachrome 64, Tri-X 400, T-Max 100, HP5, Tri-X 7266), 7 prints (Endura Premier, Ultra Endura, Ektacolor Edge,
Portra Endura, Crystal Archive, Vision 2383 / 2393), 9 formats (off, 8 mm 4.8, Super 8 5.79, 16 mm 10.26, Super 16 12.52, Super
35 24.89, 35 mm 36, 645 56, 6x7 70). A 33^3 LUT in ~65 ms (PC); FilmChain bakes the simulation then the chosen LUT into the one
table ArkCombine (FILM_LUT) and both viewfinders apply. Effects on the GPU in micrometres of film / frame pixel size:
FilmHalation (linear light before the tone: the image's gaussdown pyramid around 65 um still / 50 um cine, three bounces, energy
kept, R > G > B by the antihalation), FilmGrain (after the final resize: film MTF blur, grain by Selwyn's law from the stock's RMS
at the larger of the pixel and the grain, through the print's contrast, tonal weight, layers partly shared, blue coarser).
UI: «Плёночная симуляция» page (FilmSimPreference: preview on the samples, tabs Плёнка / Печать / Формат / Эффекты: grain,
halation, softness, film exposure, print exposure, print tone, strength), the viewfinder tray's film row (after the filters), the
pill names the stock; the lab compares every film setting. Tests FilmSimTest (every stock x print: monotonic neutral grey scale,
mid grey, hues kept, B&W grey, LUT time, the chain, grain vs format). Not on the phone yet: the look, the grain size, the
halation; the viewfinder shows the colour and tone only.

### P282 - single-frame remosaic where the donors were rejected (owner, 2026-10-19: «улучшить ремозаик для однокадра sabre чтобы улучшить движение в случае реджекта для quad и quad quad, заодно и для bayer»; ArkCam 1.70 / 1.71 shown as the example): Quad and Tetra pushed in 52adf573; Bayer done locally.
A pass after the native fast merge (NAT_DEMOSAIC program of kHybMergeMosaicFast; kHybMergeMain1 untouched): where the donors'
accepted frames F are below the widening's K the output takes t = baseDemosaic (1 - smoothstep(0, K, F)) of the base frame's
own demosaic at the site position (skipped inside the Bento mask, at clipped or flagged sites, with the ultrashort frame).
The demosaic (our own, after ArkCam 1.71's idea of a green-equivalent subpixel luma): cells of 2x2 sites (3x3 Quad, 5x5 Tetra
around the site); direction from the intra-cell gradients, same-colour cells and - only where one pairing finds no colour -
the row / column cross-phase disagreement (a saturated flat colour gave a false direction); colour differences R - G, B - G per
red / blue cell against its own row's and column's nearest greens, cells weighted by distance (narrowed across the edge) and by
how close their green is to the green at the site (a red / green edge flips R - G: the side the site belongs to); Gr / Gb
disagreement damps the colour (aliasing); every site of a cone stretched along the edge gives a green equivalent (red / blue
weighted down where the colour is strong; Quad: also by the distance to the greens' value), luma clamped to the greens' range.
Tuning baseDemosaic (1; 0 = off, as before), baseDemosaicAniso (0.6), baseDemosaicDetailLo / Hi (0 / 0.01: the noise gate
is off - the base noise model reads too low to gate on it). The program is prewarmed with the native set.
Replay on the OPPO (syn_b2 / syn_b4 with GT, cdm 1e6 = no donor anywhere; dB luma full / low-passed): Quad zone plate
+2.5 / +2.2, bars +4.8, bars false colour 0.083 -> 0.001, coloured bars +2.1, lattice 2487 -> 176, edges -1.8 / +0.7 (the
remaining loss: red / green edges); Tetra zone plate +3.2 / +5.3, bars +5.6, false colour 0.016 -> 0.001, coloured bars +3.3,
lattice 3612 -> 133, edges -0.1 / +4.3. Moving bursts (syn_b2m / b4m): moving zone plate +1.0 dB both, static regions
unchanged. Real bursts hand / isz2 / t100546: 0.6-1.9 % of the pixels change, no artefact seen, merge time within run noise.
Cost (Adreno 750, programs cached): Quad +0.24 s with motion, +0.85 s with no donor at all; Tetra +0.9 s / +2.5 s. A shared-
memory tile of the sites was tried and was slower (9 s): dropped. Open: the red / green edges of Quad, the Tetra cost, phone shots
of moving subjects.
Round 2 (local, after f89d4ce0): Quad red / green edges - the colour differences were mixed by cells lying on the edge
(their own sites disagree): such a cell (or its row / column partner) is weighted down by its intra-cell spread (Quad only:
on Tetra it lost detail), the green-similarity tau tightened (1.5 sigma + 1.5 % instead of 3 sigma + 8 %). syn_b2 no donor:
edges 41.7 -> 42.4 dB (base 43.5), the rest within 0.1 dB; Tetra edges 38.7 -> 38.9. Speed: the per-cell arrays sized by the
block (9 Quad, 25 Tetra) and the cell offsets kept in an array - recomputing them, a cache of the sites (100 floats) or a
shared-memory tile all made Adreno 750 spill registers and run 1.3-2.5x slower. Cost with no donor at all (cached programs):
Quad 1.37 s vs 0.50 s off, Tetra 3.2 s vs 0.65 s off - the same as before the edge fix; with ordinary motion only the rejected
area pays. A faster Tetra needs one invocation per 2x2 sites (shared cell statistics): not done.
Bayer (local, after 52adf573): kHybChroma (the plain merge's colour-difference pass, on by default) blends the base's own
demosaic by the same share (1 - smoothstep(0, K, F); by the cover without the 6.1 mode): a 9x9 site neighbourhood (false at a
clipped / flagged site, outside the Bento mask), direction from the 3x3 sites' green differences and same-colour Laplacians,
green at red / blue sites along it with half the Laplacian correction (bounded to the four greens' range +-50 %), green at the
position bilinear, R - G / B - G from the 5x5 core weighted by distance (narrowed across the edge) and green similarity. A noise
gate (structure / noise of the 3x3 gradients, ~1 on noise; baseDemosaicBayerLo / Hi 1.3 / 2.5) keeps flat areas on the merge's
wider kernel (the sky's noise doubled without it). zip.nch with no donor (eval_zipper): edge PSNR 34.8 -> 40.4 dB, zipper
1.64 -> 0.82 %, edge false colour 0.028 -> 0.022, sky noise 0.289 % unchanged. syn_b1 (GT = gt_shift_b2 shifted by half a
site, cubic: its high frequencies are soft) with no donor: edges +3.5 dB, zone plate +1.8 / +15 low-passed, coloured zone plate
-2.5 (beyond Nyquist), bars +-0.5; with donors unchanged. Cost: +1.45 s with no donor at all on 12 MP, real bursts within run
noise (x7u_1x, o12; Quad main511 / uw452 0.001-0.1 % of the pixels change by more than 1 %).

### P286 - film simulation as the reference app (owner, 2026-10-19: «Перепроверь также все пленочные симуляции, у нас все не работает нормально, сделай максимально близко к [приложению-образцу] ... если можешь один в один, делай один в один. Но стиль меню и тд делай наш»; licence choice: one to one with attribution): done, not device-tested.
The reference app is a closed Vulkan port of spektrafilm (Andrea Volpato, GPL-3.0 code, CC BY-SA 4.0 profiles; its .so shows
the shader and data names). We port spektrafilm itself:
- data: research/filmsim/export.py runs spektrafilm 0.3.4 (commit 3bb2c2d, a Python 3.12 venv with stubs for its image I/O)
  and writes assets/film/<stock>.bin (SFD1 container): per film the linear sRGB -> XYZ matrix (CAT16 to its reference
  illuminant), the Hanatos 2025 raw LUT 192^2 (fp16, its input gamut compression baked in), log exposure, density curves, the
  sub-layer curves, channel and base densities, the DIR matrix of its stock defaults; per paper the sensitivities, the fitted
  curves and the scan (density -> encoded sRGB with its CAM16 output gamut compression) as a 33^3 LUT; per slide its scan;
  shared.bin the TH-KG3 lamp, the dichroic filters, the neutral print filter database. 7.2 MB. LICENSE-spektrafilm.txt and
  CHANGELOG.txt beside them, the credit in Settings -> About («Данные плёночной симуляции»).
- FilmSpectral (Java): the per-pixel pipeline - Hanatos raw (Mitchell cubic, reflected edges), film exposure, develop with
  the curves before the couplers and the DIR inhibition, the enlarger (neutral filters + the user's M / Y shifts) through the
  dye densities onto the paper (NaN densities pass no light, as density_to_light), print exposure normalised on the mid grey
  of this film exposure, the paper curves, the scan LUT. Matches spektrafilm's output (spatial / stochastic effects off) within
  0.003 of the encoded value on 13 film / paper / exposure / filter cases (research/filmsim/refs.py, FilmSpectralTest).
- FilmSim: the stocks are the reference's 20 colour films (Portra 160/400/800/800 push 1/2, Gold 200, Ultramax 400, Ektar 100,
  C200, X-Tra 400, Pro 400H, Vision3 50D/200T/250D/500T, Verita 200D, Ektachrome 100, Provia 100F, Velvia 100, Kodachrome
  64) and its 8 prints (Portra / Endura Premier / Ultra / Supra Endura, Ektacolor Edge, Crystal Archive Type II, Vision 2383 /
  2393); a stock without a chosen print takes its maker's; the P281 ids map to the new ones; the black-and-white stocks (no
  data in the reference) stay on our model with its paper. Settings: «Контраст плёнки» (density_curve_gamma x0.7..x1.4),
  «Фильтр M / Y увеличителя» (+-30 CC). The LUT input: the display colour back to scene light as before.
- Grain (FilmGrain, film/grain_sf.glsl): the reference's particle model (Poisson-binomial per sub-layer; its variance formula
  checked against its Monte Carlo within 1 %, research/filmsim/grainchk.py), per layer independent Gaussian density noise
  blurred 0.65 px, seen through the print and the scan by a 17^3 LUT over the picture's colour of |d out / d density| x sigma.
- Halation (FilmHalation): the reference's in-emulsion scatter (core 2.2 / 2.0 / 1.6 um + exponential tail 9.3 / 9.7 / 9.1 um,
  weight 0.78 / 0.65 / 0.67, the tail as its three-Gaussian fit; «Мягкость плёнки» = the scatter's size; film/scatter.glsl,
  separable) and its halation sum of three bounces G(sigma_h sqrt(k)) weighted 1, 1/2, 1/4 (film/blur.glsl on the pyramid
  level under half the first bounce's width, film/halo_sum.glsl), energy kept.
Not on a phone yet: the look of every stock, the grain and halation sizes, the LUT build time (~0.1 s on the PC).

### P288 - exact FFT convolution of the lens filters (owner, 2026-10-19: «Сделай точную FFT-свёртку, если это возможно»): done, not device-tested.
A full-size FFT of the whole PSF does not fit a phone (the bloom reaches across the frame). DiffusionFft: each exponential of
the PSF on the box-pyramid level where its decay is 4..8 px (narrower ones on the image itself), cut at the reference's
radius (8 x the bloom's largest decay, at most half the image; a narrow one at 12 decays), the PSF normalised as one like the
reference; one FFT per level (overlapping tiles of 1024 with the kernel's radius as border where a level is larger); the
levels summed from the coarsest, each bilinearly enlarged. Against the reference's single full-size convolution on a 320 x 240
night scene at a 12 MP frame's scale: glow error 0.04 / 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.1 % of the peak (Glimmerglass / BPM / Pro-Mist /
CineBloom), energy within 1 % (DiffusionFftTest). A component under half a pixel (only on a preview) is its pixel mean
instead of a point sample (a point sample left no glow). The photo: LensFilter on the GPU (lensfft/load, fft - radix-2
Stockham passes, the same index math as the Java -, mul, store, down, carry); the settings' preview the same plan on the CPU;
the live viewfinder keeps the pyramid fit (LiveLensFilter). Not on a phone yet: correctness of the GPU passes, the time
(12 MP: about 70 FFT planes of 1024^2 at level 0).

### P289 - film settings' sliders and lens filters on the photo (owner, 2026-10-20: «фото сохранилось без фильтра. все эти ползунки не работают нормально, исправь», «посмотри как это реализовано в [приложении-образце] и исправь у нас»): done, not device-tested.
Causes: the GPU FFT passes left the photo without its filter (no glow in the owner's shot); the film's exposure was
compensated by the print (the EV slider changed nothing); grain, halation and softness were only in the photo's spatial
passes, never in the settings' preview. As the reference: each exponential of the filter's PSF is three Gaussians
(DiffusionGauss.FIT, amplitudes .1633 / .6496 / .1870 at sigma / decay .536 / 1.5236 / 2.7684), each blurred separably on the
box-pyramid level where its sigma is 3..6 px (mirror edges), the levels summed from the coarsest with bilinear enlargement;
on the GPU lensgauss/down, blur (x, then y accumulating), up; the settings' preview the same plan on the CPU. Error against the
exact convolution (DiffusionFft, now a test reference) under 0.1 of the peak, CineBloom 0.25, energy within 5 %
(DiffusionGaussTest). Film exposure uncompensated (the print normalised on the mid grey at EV 0). The settings' preview shows
scatter, halation (FilmEffects.light) and grain (FilmEffects.grain) as a 1:1 crop of a 4000 px photo. Grain: the reference's
defaults (particle area 0.1 um2, colour scale 1.2 / 1.0 / 2.5, sub-layers 6 / 1 / 0.4, dmin .04 / .05 / .06, uniformity
.99 / .97 / .98) and its final blur of 11.8 um; on the GPU film/noise -> film/blur x / y -> film/grain_sf. Slider ranges as the
reference: grain 0..200 %, halation 0..400 %. Viewfinder tray (owner: «сделай красивый интерфейс для списка, который
вызывается в видоискателе, и дай возможность закрывать это подменю нажатием на пустой видоискатель»): three titled sections
(LUT with «Все LUT ›» and the strength, lens filter, film) with the current choice after each title, rounded chips with the
chosen one filled in the accent; a tap on the empty viewfinder closes the tray without focusing (Swipe.onSingleTapUp).

### P290 - stepped contours on a lamp-lit sheet, echo sounder (owner, 2026-10-20, X200 Ultra bursts scam_burst-20261019-231619 / 231640; then «переходы плавные и мягкие, как на Арк, но больше информации»): merge fixed (replay), tone open, not device-tested.
Cause (replay on the OPPO, clip-flag trailer): inside the base's clipped highlight the result comes from the ultrashort frames alone
(Bento), scaled by one ratio for the frame (GAIN CHECK 0.1399, MAD 9.6 %: consistent; row profile: 15 of 48 bands agreeing, none).
The 2.8 ms frames caught the desk lamp on another flicker phase than the ceiling lamps: under the desk lamp the per-colour ratio
was 0.08..0.11, so the clipped part of the sheet came out up to 30 % darker and greener than the unclipped paper, the border along
the clip on the binned cells. Fix: hybridUltrashortLocal after the row profile - 16 x 16 tiles of the ultrashort frame against the
base (both unclipped, colours with signal, smooth base, 5 x 5 median outlier test), log green ratio and R/G, B/G, filled into
unmeasured tiles (the clipped highlight) by normalised convolution from 32 tiles to 1; applied when a factor within 4 tiles of the
base's clipped tiles departs by mosaicUsRowsMin (8 %) or more (binned frame, split sub-frames, native sites at upload via
HybridMosaicNative::local, T2 Quad sites, plain path copy). Tuning key usLocal (1; 0 = rows only). Replay: 231619 and 231640
contours gone (smooth gradient), ceiling lamp unchanged in look; static references syn_b1/b2/b4, hand, isz2, q1x, o12, main511 bit
for bit with the previous worker; t100526 / t100546 (flickering scenes) changed <1 % on average in the most changed area.
check_hybrid_us_rows: lamp case (ring error 19.9 % -> 1.8 %, under the clip 27.7 % -> 9.2 %; native vs binned 1 DN).
Echo sounder: the red top line's blue segments are on the screen itself (the reference camera's shot shows them the same); the
screen is not clipped in the merge, nothing of Bento there. Open: the tone of the sheet («мягко, как у Арк, но больше
информации») - post pipeline (ArkCombine highlight roll-off), needs a shot of the new build / lab A/B.

### P291 - soft light on the lamp-lit sheet, «максимально похоже на Арк, но с чуть большим количеством информации» (owner, 2026-10-20): done on the host, not device-tested.
After P290 the sheet still had a dark ring round the white core. Host stand (session scratchpad art289/ark_host.py: the app's
ark/low, bracket_dn, gf/box/ab fusion, hlmask, combine on the PC GPU with the shot's AE values from the phone log; it reproduces
the phone JPEG of 231619 incl. the steps; colours calibrated to the JPEG by a 3x3 fit): the exposure fusion itself is not
monotonic with Bento headroom - em = (0.029, 1, 1.5, 2.25): past the base layer's saturation the weights move to the 5 EV darker
layer and the fused luma falls (0.81 at I 0.55 -> 0.72 at I 2.3) before it climbs to white. Shoulder / landing / guide /
radius / eps changed nothing of it. Fix (ark/gf.glsl MODE 3, monoU, key hybrid_ark_fusion_mono, default 0.04): the fusion's
own neutral curve F(I) lifted to its envelope max over I' <= I with F(I') >= 0.5 of F(I') + monoU ln(I / I'), the difference
added to the guided result; a curve that never falls (usual layers, em.x >= 0.15) is unchanged. 231619 profile from the core:
254 .. 223 203 166 160 163 171 179 .. (ring) -> 254 .. 234 229 218 212 209 203 199 193 (monotonic); 231640: 11 % of the
pixels change (lamp-lit areas). check_ark_tone: vivo cases pass; its two synthetic cases fail the same on HEAD (not this change).
Owner's idea (2 ultrashort + 1 short frame between them and the normal ones): answered in chat, not built.
P291 round 2 (owner: «сделай ещё ближе к Арк камере», «белый никогда не уходил в серый»): the lit paper was grey because with
Bento headroom the fusion's highlight layer is ~2 EV darker than ArkCam's (em.x 0.038 at hr 22 against ~0.125 on clipped data)
and the kernel's weights (centre 0.6, highlight layer 0.8) take it. With headroom (r.hr > 0) ArkFusion now uses centre 0.75 and
highlight-layer weight 0.4 (keys hybrid_ark_weight_center_hr / _weight_hl_hr); without headroom as before. Host replay, sheet
points 255 255 254 249 227 210 / shaded part 132 against ArkCam 246 248 249 249 234 199 / 130 (before 208 .. 147 / 95);
231619 from the core 255 .. 254 251 248 243 238 231 227 217 209 205, monotonic. Left as is: ArkCam's frame is ~1.3 EV brighter
in the mid-tones and lifts the shadows (median luma 77 against 28) - a global AE / shadow change, not this scene's highlights.

Those sessions show the developed RAW (no ISP stream); it had no lens-filter pass. With a filter chosen MainRenderer draws the RAW
frame into an off-screen RGBA8 target of the viewport's size and puts it on screen through the ISP viewfinder's own shaders made
2D (LiveLensFilter.to2d: main_fs + lensfilter_live, lensfilter_prep; VS_2D), a second LiveLensFilter without its own LUT (the RAW
frame has it: the filter comes after the LUT here, before it on the ISP path). No filter: as before, no extra pass. A failed
program or target leaves the RAW viewfinder as before. Shaders: glslc ES 3.1 and desktop link OK; LiveLensFilterTest.

### P302 - photos and RAW back to DCIM (owner, 2026-10-20): done, not device-tested.
«/storage/emulated/0/Download/SCAMERA/DCIM/Camera/ и /storage/emulated/0/Download/SCAMERA/DCIM/SCAMERA/Raw/ перенести обратно в
/storage/emulated/0/DCIM/. Это всё не нужно хранить в загрузках.» Cause: SimpleStorageHelper.updateFileManagerPaths took the first
lasting folder grant whatever it was and appended "DCIM/" - since P191 that was the Download/SCAMERA grant, so photos and DNGs went
to Download/SCAMERA/DCIM/...; hasStorageAccess counted that grant as DCIM access (the DCIM picker was never shown). Now dcimOf
takes only a grant of DCIM, of a folder in it or of a storage root (primary first), else the primary DCIM (the File API writes
photos and DNGs there); hasStorageAccess the same. DcimMoveBack (once, in the background at the camera's start): the files of
Download/SCAMERA/DCIM/Camera and .../DCIM/SCAMERA/Raw go to DCIM/Camera and DCIM/SCAMERA/Raw - renamed where the File API allows,
else copied, read back and compared byte for byte, then the old one deleted (File API, else through the Download/SCAMERA grant);
the same bytes already there: the old one goes; another file of the name: "_1"; anything that cannot be read or deleted stays for
the next start; media scan of both places; empty old folders removed; done once nothing is left. DcimMoveBackTest (CI).

### P301 - the viewfinder shows the photo's tone (owner, 2026-10-20: «тонмапинг ... в живом видоискателе? Результат должен совпадать с итоговым фото», «Делай»; «нужно, чтобы RAW-видоискатель можно было включить не только для ISZ и фулреза»): done, not device-tested.
Before: the ISP viewfinder shows the ISP's own tone (our LUT / film / filter on top); the RAW viewfinder ArkCore at its library
defaults (ACES, per-pixel fusion, its own meter) - neither the photo's ARK tone. Now the developed-RAW viewfinder runs the photo's
own shaders (LiveArkTone, the viewfinder's GL thread): rawdevelop_fs u_linear_out gives the frame's linear sRGB (WB, lens
shading, color_transform; no tone), then ark/low, ArkAe on a factor-8 arkLow read back every 4 frames (smoothed), ark/gf + box +
ab (the guided-filter fusion with the photo's weights and P291 envelope), ark/combine with the photo's settings (tone operator,
colour look, film simulation / LUT), into the off-screen target; the 2D filter pass (P300) puts it on screen with the lens filter
and the focus peaking. Differences left: the merge's noise and detail (detail off), no Bento headroom (one frame), the AE's noise
clamp from the frame's noise over 0.55 x the burst's frames, the AE's statistics at factor 8. Any GL failure switches it off for
the context (the RAW viewfinder's own look). scam_dev.txt "vf_ark 0": as before. The RAW viewfinder on any module: «Живой
видоискатель» (settings and the sheet's «Для опытных»), or the module's «Поток ISP: Выкл»; DeviceDefaults v6 turns it on once on
flagship SoCs (SM8650 / SM8750 / SM8850, MT6989 / MT699x). Open: frame rate and look on a phone.

  parity each, so the even and the odd columns were filtered apart and the colour alternated pixel by pixel along edges (79 % of
  the R/G second differences alternated, 59 % before the median). The medians the blend takes are smoothed by [1 2 1] x [1 2 1]
  for d >= 2 (Tetra; Quad on the Sabre 2x grid), CPU stream, GPU path and the reference of check_chroma_band.

  the scene 1.4 %), R / B edge misregistration on the stacks 0.61 / 0.39 -> 0.19 / 0.33 px; the letters' colour and the width of
  real colour transitions (lifeboat 13 px, hull on the sea 20 px) unchanged. Quad 2x (q1x): false colour above 5 % 25.3 -> 20.3 %.
- Tetra is a daylight shot: the Tetra night kernel point (kernel 1, edge 0.4, flat x4) is no longer taken (the HP9's site key is
  28 even at ISO 50, under s61MaxKey 30); the 200 MP text's 1.2-2.4 px band +10 %, noise unchanged.
- 200 MP denoise on again (P179 had the merge alone), on the 2x2 means (ScamDenoise's Sabre 2x grid path: pyramids at the 50 MP
  scale), a flat strength map 4.3 (no effective-frame map above 100 MP, P187; without it every pixel counted as fully merged and the

  skips it with a log line; «Шумоподавление» off leaves the merge alone. scam_dev: hybrid_dn_huge_map, hybrid_dn_huge_fine.
- Checked: Bayer / Quad replays bit-identical to the HEAD worker (syn_b1, syn_b2, x7u_1x, hand, isz2, nat_n8_b2, uw, the 50 MP

### P308 - everything on the GPU (owner, 2026-10-20: «нам нужно перевести всё на гпу»): DONE, not device-tested in the app.
The CPU steps of a shot today: the chroma median and false-colour suppression above 16.8 MP (MosaicChromaStream: every 50 / 200 MP
mosaic merge; ChromaMedianGpu below that size), the oscillation map of the base sites, the site-class response and its field, the
binning of the native mosaic frames, the shift to the RGGB origin, the outlier statistics, the row profiles of the ultrashort
frames; app side: the Java steps around the merge. Each one on the GPU with the same results (bit-exact where the CPU path
promised it, else float rounding), memory at 200 MP in strips, timings before / after on the X200 Ultra and the OPPO.
Owner, same day: «сделай гпу выравнивание и дай возможность выбора»; «один в один выравнивание как Арк Кам не делаем, если возможно
переводим наше на гпу»; «постарайся ускорить гпу выравнивание когда закончишь перенос»; «на качество ускорение не должно влиять».
- F6 on the GPU: DONE, not device-tested in the app. `scam-la-gpu.h` (LaGpu): our laGray / laDown / laBaseLevel / laTilePass / laLK /
  laMedian3 / laMotionExtent / laFrameField as GLES 3.1 compute, 16 invocations per tile (4 tiles a workgroup, shared-memory
  reduction), base levels as rgba32f textures (masked value, gx, gy), the donor's bilinear quad one textureGather, two frames in
  flight (submit / collect; no zero uploads: the first LK iteration clears the stop flags). Context, programs and base pyramid built
  on a thread of their own during the alignment (laGpuAhead), released there and taken by the merge thread; any failure -> the CPU
  field (whole-field path). Worker key `laGpu` (default 0: replays unchanged); app ListPreference `pref_scam_hybrid_la_engine`
  «Где считать F6» GPU (default, HYBRID_DEFAULTS la_engine 1) / CPU, greyed out with F6 off; HybridSettingsTest p308.
  OPPO Find X7 Ultra replays (same worker): the field equals the CPU's up to float rounding (merge max abs 0.00043, PSNR 124.5 dB;
  stats identical), laGpu 0 bit-identical to before (b50 50e4f6ad, hh_1 63519568, x7u_1x c2f295fa); every GPU variant below gave
  the same output (b50 6433c787). Per 12 MP frame: thread per tile 77 ms -> workgroup 67 -> textures + vec4 sums ~55 -> pipelined
  21.6 ms (b50: 12 frames 266 ms; hh_1 24 frames 159 ms; x7u_1x 34 frames 592 ms). Shot totals GPU / CPU: b50 12144 / 12196 ms,
  hh_1 3427, 3366 / 3344, 3395 ms, x7u_1x 3347, 3366 / 3340, 3469 ms; the merge 0.3-0.7 s faster with the processor free.
  hh_1 still waits ~100 ms for the context (its alignment is shorter than the compile).

  streams, the GPU md5 with laStream 0).

### P311 - LED rings without lines in the ARK tone: the AgX path to white over 1.3 EV, the detail delta at the rim of a clipped light (owner, 2026-10-21, OPPO X8U photo of the PC on f9489748: a pink fan ring with a white core, a hard edge on its outer side and a crimson line along its inner side; «сделай ещё лучше»): DONE, not device-tested in the app.
- The linear merge is clean at the rings (the LED burst replayed on the OPPO with the final P310 worker); both lines come from the
  ARK tone (host chain SCR p310/led_host.py, phone sharpening; harness SCR p311/ref: render.py, score.py = dips / cliffs / colour
  bands at six ring and bar locations, regress.py = seven scenes, changes outside the light edges, speck.py = roughness along the
  rings; a synthetic merge with lines, holes, rims and LED rows).
- Outer side: my own P310 gate of the AgX path to white, smoothstep(0.8, 0.995 x the AgX white): 0.3 EV, inside one pixel of a ring's
  falloff (~0.3 EV per px), so the other channels (lifted to 15 % of the brightest one) fell 3.5 EV in a pixel after a plateau (blue
  ring R 180 -> 96 in 2 px; pink: the white core breaking off into the saturated glow). Now 0.8 .. 2.0 x the white: pixels below 0.8 x
  unchanged, from 2 x up the former core; nothing else in the tone moves (check_colour_output: the baseline with the same edit).
- Inner side (and with that fix the outer side too): the bounded detail delta of combine.glsl dug a lobe 2-6 px wide beside a
  clipped light - its reference (the B-spline of the arkLow box means of min(m Y, 1)) holds the light's spill, the cube root of
  that linear mix lifts it far more than the base (the fusion mixes in the display domain), plus ArkLumaSharpen's undershoot at
  that edge. Rule (lightShare / lightRimDelta): the light share of the arkLow taps (max channel 2 .. 4 x the reference's bound, or
  the geometric mean of max channel and luminance 1.4 .. 2.4 x), its mass / first / second moment in a disc of 4 arkLow px, side =
  |M|^4 / (H M'SM) (1 = the light on one side: a rim, 0 = around the pixel: a dark line or hole in front of a light), the reference
  of the far side (the footprint taps behind the pixel, away from the light), and at a rim the negative delta against that far
  side, never deeper than the plain delta; blended by side 0.3 .. 0.7 and the disc's light mass 0 .. 2. Every input smooth in the
  position; no light in the footprint = bit for bit as before.
- Rejected on the way (measured): a per-pixel rim test on the sharpened pixel with a 'valley' 2-3 px further out (dotted dark
  lines along the rings: its decision followed the noise); a local-slope compression of the delta (design C: LED scores as good,
  but dark wires 1-3 px within 4 px of a blown window lost 50-75 % of their contrast and lights at 4-6 x white got dashed rims);
  the 16-tap footprint share as the gate (dashed rims at lights of ~2 x white and LED rows: review, replaced by the disc mass).
- Measured (host, phone sharpening; mean LED score over six locations, lower = better, the reference app's own JPEG 25): blue
  burst 55.7 -> 28.6, the pink channel swap 47.1 -> 27.5, the burst without the ultrashort frames 45.6 -> 25.3; the complaint ring's
  inner dip 41 -> ~1 codes; no rise of the roughness along the rings; synthetic dark lines 3/4/6 px and holes r3/r5 in front of a 4 x
  light unchanged, below-white cells bit-identical; o12 / x7u_1x / d1655 / d1853 outside the light edges <= 0.003 % of the pixels
  (d1655 bit-identical), the changes there trenches removed at lamps and blown windows. Open: colour band at a non-white saturated
  core (now visible instead of the dark line: the core-colour / path-to-white question), lights below ~2 x white keep part of the

### P312 - the camera's start without a frozen viewfinder: the developed-RAW viewfinder's programs from driver binaries (owner, 2026-10-21, a video of three starts on the vivo X200 Ultra: «вот такие лаги ловлю при запуске»): DONE, not device-tested.
- Cause (the video against the log): the viewfinder stood still 0.4 s at every start (2.1 - 2.5 s cold) right after its first
  frames - the gap between the last ISP frame drawn and «the photo's ARK tone on». At the first RAW frame the viewfinder's GL thread
  compiled from source rawdevelop (650 lines) and the ten programs of the photo's ARK tone (combine 815 lines); no ISP frame could
  be drawn meanwhile (the camera kept 30 fps: STAB_TRACE maxGap 66 ms). The post pipeline's program binaries (P30 / P69) never
  covered the viewfinder.
- GLProg: viewfinder keys ("V\n" + attributes + vertex + U+0001 + fragment) in the same driver-binary cache (process + disk;
  cachedViewfinderProgram / linkViewfinderProgram / viewfinderProgram; the idle warm-up recompiles them after a driver update; not
  counted in the shot's "programs:" line; stale GL errors drained before glProgramBinary). LiveRawRenderer / LiveArkTone: their
  programs through it, prepare() before the first draw (pending first, then the binary; a refused or missing binary goes to the
  background once, else compiled in place); MainRenderer's own four programs too. ViewfinderPrograms: the keys without a binary
  compiled on a background thread in a context of its own (display priority). MainRenderer: the ISP frame stays until the programs
  are linked (no load while the background links: a driver's compiler lock), then straight to the ARK tone; a RAW-only session
  (ISZ / FULLRES) shows the plain RAW look as soon as rawdevelop is there; the ARK set asked again when it becomes wanted; 8 s
  deadline, then as before; the GL state put back after the set-up.
- Expected: a start with binaries links them in a few ms (the first RAW frame keeps ~40-120 ms: the 24 MB upload, the ARK targets,
  the first AE readback); the first start after an install compiles in the background while the ISP viewfinder runs.
- Checks: GLProgramDiskCacheTest (keys round trip, kept for the warm-up, not counted), two code reviews (fixed: the pending/cache
  race, per-frame key building, stats leak, stale errors, no deadline, RAW-only sessions). Open: the phone (VF_DRAW at a cold start).

### P313 - vivo 2x ISZ in daylight: the highlights' detail back (the ultrashort frames fill only what the N frames clipped), no false flicker correction (owner, 2026-10-21, vivo X200 Ultra 2x ISZ, burst scam_burst-20261021-101423.bin: «все фото в области светов очень мыльное и с кучей артефактов» + «почему-то обработка фото с isz занимает кучу времени»): DONE in the worker, not device-tested in the app.
- Soft highlights (the linear merge already; the post passes the same share of detail for every merge - host chain set up with the
  shot's parameters, verified against the phone JPEG within 1 DN): on the native Quad merge Bento took the N frames and the base
  down by (1 - m) in every mask cell and gave the cell to the single ultrashort frame's wide isotropic kernel (sigma ~2 native px);
  the merge's high-pass at 0.70..0.97 of the clip was 100 % the ultrashort frame's (0.21..0.53 of the N frames' detail) although the
  N frames clipped only 1.9 % of the pixels; the P309 ramp only widened the area; a moving flag came out twice. mosaicUsFill 1 (the
  app always sends it; worker default 0 = replays unchanged; dev switch hybrid_us_fill): the fast native merge runs as without
  Bento and a pass after it (NAT_US_PASS, a variant of kHybMergeMosaicFast - the merge program's own text untouched: on Adreno 750
  any edit of it made the merge 9..30x slower) mixes the ultrashort colour in by the merge's own clipped share of its kernel weight
  (one share for R, G, B, raising only). Detail slope against the no-Bento merge in the five owner regions: 0.24..0.59 -> 0.80..1.0;
  clipped areas keep the ultrashort data (no new clipping, the dark values below the N clip gone: 28 % -> 0.2 %); the ghost flag
  gone; isz2 (OPPO 2x ISZ) and v10_2 (vivo Tetra LED) cleaner the same way; merge time unchanged (OPPO 7.7 s). The app's crash ladder
  can drop the pass alone (ScamHybridBurst.STEP_US_FILL -> mosaicUsFill 0).
- Blotches: the P290 tile check compared the base and the ultrashort frame without aligning them (16 x 4 sensor px of hand
  between them) and decided by the single largest deviation: the edges of clipped white objects read x0.52..1.79 and a frame the
  row check had found clean was 'corrected' (up to +25 % brightness, +-8 % colour in the highlights). usLocalAlign 1 (default):
  the tiles measured at the frames' global translation (hybridUsGlobalShift: globalShift on block means + a 2x2-site refinement, an
  alias guard at 1/16 of the frame), the decision against the frame's own level. The ISZ shot: 'at the shift (2, 8) px ... 4.9 % ->
  as captured'; the lamp / LED bursts keep their correction, now registered (lower cross-validated residual); usLocalAlign 0 =
  P290 bit for bit. With the alignment the decision is the 4th-largest deviation near the clip, not the single largest: a lamp
  on another flicker phase moves many tiles, one to three are a moving object or what the global shift leaves (the ISZ burst's third
  ultrashort frame: 8.3 % on its worst tile -> as captured; o12's paper in the wind 9.6 -> 6.0 %; every lamp / LED burst unchanged).
  Not fixed: the post-correction gain check never counts a tile on mosaic bursts (rms over all Bayer sites).
- Three ultrashort frames on Quad / Tetra (owner: «почему только один ультракороткий, если мы снимаем 3?» + «нам нужно чтобы Тетра и
  квад брали 3 ультракоротких кадра»): the native pick put them into N slots (28 N + 1 + 1 of 30 on the ISZ burst: a second one
  there would have raised the noise over the 97 % of the frame its clip does not cover). With the fill every ultrashort frame Bento
  takes (bentoFrames, at most 3) gets a slot of its own on top of mosaicFrames and ahead of the N frames (hybridMosaicPick with
  the ultrashort frames reserved): the ISZ burst 32 of 36 frames with all 3 ultrashort frames ('3 ultrashort in slots of their own
  (the ultrashort fill)'), merge 7.8 s on the OPPO; isz2 / t100526 / v10 the same rule. Pre-push review: only as many own slots as
  the raise of mosaicFrames got through the memory budget (budget with the raise - budget without it; a budget short of the raise
  would trade N frames for them: the noise outside the clip up), else the P219 pick ('no slots of their own: the memory budget');
  only where the fill runs (the fast native merge: full window 1..3 sites, Tetra T1 1..8, not the generic merge - the report of
  the fill there too); every bracketed frame as in P219 (the reserved ones ahead of the N frames, the others in the free slots).
- Long frames (owner: «я не вижу пользы от длинных кадров, они точно работают?» + «длинных достаточно 2-3, 5 не нужны»): they work
  where they can - the flat-area noise with and without them on the OPPO: hh_1 (night) -45 % in the deepest shadows, x7u_1x (night)
  -16..-19 %, o12 (day) 0 %, the vivo ISZ (day) +2 % (its long frame in an N slot), hand: all rejected by the motion gate (10-20 %
  moved > 4 %: by design, they are shot after the press at 2x the shutter). The app takes at most 3 (HybridPlan.bracketCount: a stored
  4 or 5 takes 3; the slider 1..3; the default 3 since P68). Native Quad merges at night (the kernel's night rule: the base's key61
  - one sensor site - at or below s61MaxKey; never Tetra, which P306 shoots by day only): up to 3 bracketed frames take slots of
  their own as well ('3 bracketed in slots of their own (night: key K)'); by day one keeps its N slot as in P219. On the bursts at
  hand the budget covers the whole burst (t100526, key 9.9: 26 frames, 34 slots), so the rule changes nothing there (md5 the same).
- Slow processing: not the merge - on the vivo the ARK RAW viewfinder of P301 (P266 RAW-only session: ~20 passes per frame at
  display priority) left the low-priority worker ~1/10 of the GPU: 46-51 rows/s while it ran, >= 410 rows/s once it stopped; the
  same 2x ISZ merged in 5.5 s on 10-19 with the old one-pass RAW viewfinder. Fixed in P314 (the viewfinder like the reference app's).
- Checks (worker_p313f, after the review): P306 refs (x7u_1x c2f295fa, hh_1 63519568) and the jref set (x7u_1x f51cddf6, hh_1,
  isz2 b7dd6b8d, v10_1 879fed4a, hand f3ee3a0c, o12 47f225f6) bit-identical to the P313 worker before the long-frame rule; the 14
  C++ checks and --transport-check on the OPPO (check_hybrid_prefetch once over its peak-memory bound while the phone was busy, 5 of 5
  reruns PASS); the night rule against the day ISZ burst (e6dd6c43, unchanged) and t100526 / v10_1 / v10_2 / isz2 (unchanged);
  HybridPlanTest (p313AtMostThreeShastaFrames) / HybridSettingsTest / ScamHybridBurstCrashTest / DevKeysCoverageTest.

### P314 - the RAW viewfinder as light as ArkCam's: one pass of the photo's tone at the frame's colour grid, the AE on the CPU, a frame dropped when the viewfinder is busy, the GPU at normal priority (owner, 2026-10-21: «Исправь живой видоискатель, в ArkCam он тоже есть, но при этом обработку он никак не замедляет» + «Посмотри как работает живой видоискатель в Арк камере, нам нужно сделать схожим образом»): DONE, not device-tested.
- Cause (P313's slow 2x ISZ shot): the P301 ARK RAW viewfinder drew ~20 passes a frame at the viewport (the guided-filter fusion,
  its pyramid), copied (24 MB) and uploaded the whole frame, read the picture back for the AE every 4th frame, in a HIGH-priority
  context (P90): the worker's LOW context got ~1/10 of the GPU (46-51 rows/s while it ran, >= 410 rows/s without it).
- ArkCam v174 (jadx + the engine's disassembly; notes SCR arkvf/NOTES.md): ONE full-screen pass on the packed RAW (per pixel:
  WB, lens shading, CCM, the CPU's exposure, a GLOBAL exposure-fusion curve on the pixel's own luma - no neighbourhood -, the
  look, tone map, LUT); the producer (the camera thread) drops a frame while the render thread is busy (no copy), the AE from
  <= 64 x 64 RAW samples on the CPU, no glReadPixels, no fences, no EGL priority.
- Ours now (same shape, our photo's tone): (1) GLPreview: vf_gpu_priority default 0 = MEDIUM (1 = P90's HIGH); (2) main_fs: the
  9-tap peaking average only with peaking on; (3) rawdevelop_fs: CFA mask / shift instead of % (SPIR-V OpSMod 6 -> 0);
  (4) LiveRawFrame: three buffers (acquire no longer copies), drop-when-busy (takesFrame: a frame the GL thread has not taken
  within 100 ms is replaced; CaptureController neither reads nor copies a skipped one), Quad / Tetra frames under 30 MP published
  as their cell means (drawn with cfa_mode 0: lossless against the mosaic up to 1/2 DN; the >= 30 MP bins of P108 / P179 / P181 /
  P194 unchanged); the bins on threads of their own (ParallelWork.Own: in the shared pool a shot's CPU pass held the camera thread
  for its whole length on every frame - review, desktop: 4 -> 381 ms behind a 400 ms pass); (5) the ARK tone drawn at the visible
  crop's colour grid (LiveRawRenderer.toneSize, 1/16 steps of the viewport, sized from the crop fitted to the screen - the crop of
  the previous target made 2-cycles in 139 of ~84k cases: review): 2x ISZ 810 x 1080 instead of 1440 x 1920, Tetra 450 x 600,
  1x Bayer and FULLRES the viewport; the filter / peaking pass scales it to the screen; (6) combine.glsl POINT_FUSED: the photo's
  fusion as a per-pixel curve (FusedCurve: gf fusedAt + the P291 envelope, 353 entries, unit 8), LiveArkTone vf_ark 1 (default;
  2 = the guided-filter chain, now at the tone size with its box radius scaled; 0 = off), the AE by LiveArkMeter (128 x 96 cells
  of 2 x 2 colour quads of the RAW frame -> ArkAe.smartHdr, ~1 ms on the GL thread) instead of the readback. A 2x ISZ frame:
  ~20 passes, 24 MB copy + upload, a readback, HIGH -> 3 passes at 810 x 1080, a 6 MB upload, no readback, MEDIUM. Fallbacks as
  before (ARK failure -> the plain RAW look -> the ISP viewfinder).
- Host checks: LiveArkMeter vs the photo's per-quad statistics within 1 % (ae, p50, p98, p995, effS / effH) on clean frames (the
  old factor-8 readback smeared small lights: p995 0.69 vs the photo's 0.375); POINT_FUSED vs the exact per-pixel fusedAt +
  envelope <= 0.66 codes (5 cases, TONE_OP 1 included); combine with POINT_FUSED 0 unchanged (check_colour_output --shader / --gl).
- Measured on the OPPO X7U (Adreno 750; SCR p314/lens: vfload314 renders the old and the new viewfinder with the app's shaders
  beside the 2x ISZ replay, worker output md5 7447d964 in all 50 runs): GPU per frame during a merge 20.0 -> 1.93 ms (idle phone
  24-27 -> 4.1; new: rawdevelop 0.83, combine 2.48, 2D pass 0.78 ms), GL-thread CPU 11-13 -> 2-4.6 ms, 30 fps both; the merge
  stage 7457 +- 127 ms without a viewfinder, 18515 (x2.51) with the old one drawing, 7775 +- 113 (+4.3 %) with the new one
  drawing all the time at 30 fps; on/off windows (rows/s) old 0.42, new ~1.00 at MEDIUM, 0.92 at HIGH; the bin's thread count
  (1, 3, 8) does not matter. Look (host, the app's shaders and AE classes): the vivo 2x ISZ day frame the same tone (mean dY +0.04
  codes, dE_ok 0.9) and sharper (luma high-pass 4.6 -> 6.5, the photo 9.8); colour fringes at sharp edges from the cell means'
  colour quads (chroma high-pass rms 0.66 -> 1.09, the photo 0.46) - fixed: POINT_FUSED takes the colour of the 3 x 3
  neighbourhood at the pixel's own luminance (0.51); the X8U LED night frame 0.16 EV darker (ae 2.49 -> 2.235, the full-frame
  meter 2.223: the old readback smeared the lamps), mid-tones -7 codes, the glow beside the LEDs -16..-40 codes (the point fusion
  does not lift it as the guided filter did), against the photo's mid-tones -3.9 -> -10.7 codes.
- Open: the phone (VF_DRAW draw=, HYBRID STAGES merge= and HYBRID PROGRESS rows/s on the vivo 2x ISZ with the viewfinder open;
  no P90 stutter at MEDIUM - scam_dev vf_gpu_priority 1 brings HIGH back); the darker night viewfinder
  (above; vf_ark 2 or a noise-filtered meter if the owner objects); night AE (one frame's noise raises the cells' p98 / p995:
  +37 / +74 % against the clean photo, the exposure at the noise clamp either way); flatter shadows than the photo's local fusion
  in strongly fused scenes (vf_ark 2 for an A/B); 1x sessions with an ISP stream still re-tone the same RAW frame on ISP frame
  callbacks (since P301); LiveRawRenderer.lastView keeps the frame buffer after a session (since P301, up to 25 MB).
- Checks: LiveRawFrameTest (13), LiveArkMeterTest, FusedCurveTest, LiveRawGeometryTest, ParallelWorkOwnTest (new, CI list),
  LiveRawQuadBinTest, ArkAeTest, GLProgramDiskCacheTest; glslc of rawdevelop_fs / main_fs (2D form) and the 32 combine variants;
  check_colour_output --shader / --gl --strict, check_viewfinder_look, check_settings_model, check_ui_language; two reviews
  (correctness: the bin pool and the tone-size 2-cycle fixed, the draw-request comment corrected; pre-push: LiveRawFrameTest holds
  its frames by LiveRawFrame.pendingNs instead of racing the 100 ms; measurement: the colour fringes
  fixed, MEDIUM kept, focus peaking now samples 2 tone px apart - ~3.6 screen px at 2x ISZ - left as is).

### P315 - no camera restart after a shot on any phone; the OPPO X8U 2x ISZ: viewfinder, white balance and colour; LED backlight (owner, 2026-10-21, build 31110 = 4068c161 on the OPPO Find X8 Ultra: «На оппо х8у при использовании ISZ вот такой видоискатель и после съемки камера зачем-то перезапускается, фото при этом выходят нормальные, но почему-то они обесцвеченные и с странным бб» + «проверь чтобы ни на одном смартфоне такого не было и не было перезапуска после снятия кадра» + «выясни почему хал оппо падал и исправь, можешь проверять на 7у» + the LED pair and crops: «посмотри артефакты на подсветке у нас и постарайся их исправить, так же исправь артефакты с ISZ примеров тоже» + «у isz и на верхней подсветки точками засветы»): DONE, not device-tested in the app.
- The X8U restart (log 2026-10-21 13:33 / 13:36): the module «1× (2)» on camera 2 runs SensorModeTable row 8 (4096x3072 Quad,
  the agingtest key, P276) with «Поток ISP» «Фиктивное откл.» (the ISP stream in the session, no repeating request on it) and
  RAW10. Both shots: every post-shutter request (3 ultrashort, 3 long) failed (reason 0, the RAW and the ISP buffers lost), the
  4 s series watchdog merged the 20 ring frames, the camera provider died («unknown device 2» for ~4 s). 13:33: PREVIEW_STALL
  restarted the camera; 13:36: the watchdog's rebuild got -38 (INVALID_OPERATION on a device in error), onError 4, and
  retryWithoutRequestedSensorMode blamed the mode («Режим сенсора 8 отклонён камерой; модуль снова в «Авто»») although it had
  streamed for minutes. The same flush / series / AE restore in the X8U's plain mode (ISP stream in the repeating request) and in
  the vivo ISZ modules (no ISP stream in the session) never failed. On the X7U (PHY110, the owner's go-ahead «можешь проверять на
  7у»; probe com.scamera.oppofullresprobe v12, SCR p315/probe: a RAW-only session in an agingtest row, the repeating preview, then
  abortCaptures (the HAL flush) + a STILL_CAPTURE burst of 6 manual frames + the repeating preview again): RAW_SENSOR in rows 1, 2,
  11, 20, with the ISP stream absent / in the repeating request / in the session only - 6 of 6 frames and the preview back in ~0.3 s
  every time, the provider untouched; RAW10 runs no session at all on the X7U (CamX InvalidState), so the X8U's exact case cannot be
  replayed there. Changes:
  1. mRepeatingIsp: the series frames (P90 series_viewfinder) and the AE restore frame (P54c) touch the ISP stream only when the
     repeating preview does (the X8U's series were the first requests ever on its never-started ISP stream).
  2. SensorModePick.seriesAllowed: a picked mode on an OPPO / OnePlus / realme camera shoots from the ring alone (HybridPlan.zslOnly
     with the reason; no flush, nothing after the shutter - as ArkCam's ring snapshot); scam_dev sensor_mode_series 1 sends the
     series again to test a phone.
  3. onError: a picked mode is blamed (back to Auto) only when its session never delivered a frame; else the quiet P263 reopen.
  4. FlushLossStats: a series the rescue completed (sequenceId -1: watchdog, error, closed session) does not vote (the dead HAL had
     turned the flush off for the X8U's plain 1x shots too).
- Cross-device audit of the logs (8 logs + the owner's X300U log 2026-10-21_1): the vivo X300 Ultra's ISZ module (forced sensor
  mode, no ISP stream in the session) restarted ~6 s after every shot on 31109: the AE restore frame (P54c, forced stabilisation)
  removed and re-added the viewfinder target on the preview builder, which never had it - every later preview request failed
  («CaptureRequest contains unconfigured Input/Output Surface»), the preview stopped, PREVIEW_STALL restarted; fixed by (1). The
  Xiaomi 12X (build 31093, session type 0x9001): after a complete series no preview frame came, PREVIEW_STALL restarted 4 times -
  cause in the HAL unknown; checkPreviewStall now issues the repeating preview once more for a stall that began at a shot and
  restarts only if no frame follows a second later. A failed 200 MP still restarted the camera twice (vivo X300U): once now. By
  design and kept: a 50 MP FULLRES shot on the X300U / X100U goes to the plain session for the merge and back (P200: the app was
  killed for memory and heat during 50 MP merges) - an owner decision.
- The green ISZ viewfinder: the X8U's mode 8 RAW comes without its 64 DN black pedestal (data floor 0.3-0.5 DN; the photo knew it,
  P114 «RAW black floor ... the RAW came without its black pedestal»); the RAW viewfinder subtracted the declared 64: R and B (0.45 /
  0.58 of G on grey) went to 0 first, the colour matrix's negative terms did the rest - mid-tones pure green, half the frame black
  (screenshot: luma 20-60 RGB 4.8 / 113 / 5.4). PedestalFloor: the viewfinder frame's 16x16 blocks of each channel (every 4th site,
  every 250 ms); non-zero samples under a quarter of the black in >= 2 % of the blocks prove the pedestal lost (zero padding, read
  noise around 64, a 64 -> 60 drift never do), two agreeing measurements switch the black to the frame's floor (the 3rd-lowest block
  mean, never raised in the camera session); LiveRawFrame.publish applies it (the GL develop, LiveArkMeter, LiveRawMeter); gated as
  the photo (no black override, «чёрный по данным» on), scam_dev vf_black_floor 0 off. Host model (SCR p315/vf-green/sim_vf.py) of
  the logged black, gains and matrix reproduces the screenshot; with the floor it equals the mode-1 reference. Not a P314 regression.
- The ISZ photos' colour: the OPPO sensor-mode shots took P121's mosaic white balance (the shades-of-grey p = 4 statistic read the
  LED glow on the white case: 0.985 / 0.856, 0.745 ln off camera 2's curve, projected and extrapolated to 0.625 / 0.473 = cyan whites:
  wallpaper hue 41-55 -> 188-203 deg) and, with ownNeutral, the DNG forward matrices - on the X8U's camera 2 just sRGB -> XYZ (D50),
  camera RGB as sRGB (sticker chroma x0.31 / x0.58 of the 1x shot). The HAL's neutrals in mode 8 (0.446 / 0.589, 0.435 / 0.605) are
  0.005 ln from the curve and equal the plain mode's of the same scene. Changes: MosaicNeutralResolver ROUTE_SENSOR_MODE
  (mosaicWbAtPress: an OPPO-family picked mode keeps the HAL's converged neutral on the curve, so the ISP matrix renders it);
  offLocus: a P121 estimate more than 0.4 ln from the curve gives way to the camera's neutral when that lies on the curve and away
  from its raw-grey point (logged X200U tele cases 0.23 / 0.27 unchanged); OppoTunedColor.placeholderForward: a mosaic shot of a
  camera with the placeholder forward matrices takes the plain-session table off FULLRES too, else the ISP matrix; the mosaic block
  key carries the picked mode (mode 1 and 8 shared «2|4096x3072||0» for ~100 ms after each switch) and plainColour / plainTeacher
  skip picked-mode results.
- LED backlight (the 13:18 pair and the owner's crops: two parallel bright lines along the fan rings' cores, dotted highlights):
  ark/combine.glsl fix A - no positive detail delta inside a light's footprint (lightW): the guide is clamped flat at 1 across a
  light's core while the reference takes in the dark beside it, so the positive delta ridged just inside both rims; bit for bit
  the same where no tap is a light. Host regression (SCR p311/ref/regress.py, 7 scenes, the HEAD shaders as base): outside the
  light-edge mask 0 px > 2 codes (max 1 code), d1655 / d1853 bit-identical; LED scores jb 28.6 -> 24.0, pink 27.5 -> 23.3,
  j0 25.3 -> 25.8. tools/check_colour_output.py knows the line (P315_RAIL_LINE).

  «почему у нас идёт 4ый раунд?» - «останавливай»). The common root: in the merged data a clipped LED and a clipped bright
  coloured surface look alike, and every «this is a light» rule touched other scenes.
  - The ARK tone: a white-core floor, a ceiling, the L1 landing (round 1-2: whites towards grey or new steps); the ultrashort
    blend's hue clamp (round 1).
  - The sharpening light gate (ark/sharp_light: fade the compose / RL sharpening in a light's own glow; SCR
    p315/r3-sharpen/p315_sharpen_light_r3.diff): r1 dotted dark lines along the rims; r2 the seed fired below the clip (the
    art289 x3 display text and strokes on a blue wall erased beyond sharpening-off); r3 (seed only at >= 0.995 of the raw clip,

    jb 24.0 -> 23.1, pink 23.3 -> 22.7) softens detail on clipped EXTENDED saturated surfaces (sky, signs, screens, the
    7-segment digits) to the sharpening-off level. Next idea, not built: a thinness test in the seed (an erosion of ~4 arkLow px
    keeps skies / signs / screens out).
  - The ISZ coloured-light highlight rule (scamrgb: a native-mosaic shot without highlight frames keeps a coloured LED's clipped

### P317 - film simulation and the GPU statistics on Mali (every MTK phone) (owner, 2026-10-21, vivo X300 Pro V2502A, Mali-G1-Ultra, build 31108: «вот такое словил на X300 Pro с включенной симуляцией пленки» - a white photo; then «Исправь работу на всех мтк»): DONE, not device-tested.
- White photo: a fragment shader's ints default to mediump (ESSL 3.10 4.7.4) - 16 bit on Mali. The film noise hash (film/noise.glsl
  ...) divided a 16-bit-wrapped int by 65536 in fp16: +inf, the grain added infinity, the photo white. Adreno's mediump int is 32 bit
  (no change there). GLInterface.readProgram now inserts `precision highp int` into every program without its own #version (after
  its #extension lines, with a #line fix); the film shaders declare it too; film/grain_sf.glsl guards NaN / Inf.
- ARK AE «histogram weight 0 / 0 ... CPU statistics» on every Mali shot: GLInterface.getLayouts keyed a one-line SSBO block
  ("buffer aeHistY { uint histY[]; };", ark/aestats, ultrahdr/gainmax, halfrgba) by "}", setBufferCompute bound nothing, and the
  shader saw what sat at its binding - GLBuffer's own glBindBufferBase(SSBO, name, name), right on Adreno (names 1..n) by luck,
  nothing on Mali. The parser takes the word before '{'; GLBuffer no longer binds at its name (every user binds through
  setBufferCompute); setBufferCompute / setTextureCompute throw (logged) for an unknown block instead of a stack trace to logcat;
  memoryBarrierShared() with every barrier() in aestats / gainmax / histogram (ESSL 3.10 8.14).
- ScamHdrDenoise: the usampler EffMap always has a unit of its own (a 1x1 placeholder when there is no map; unit 0 held the
  sampler2D input: GL_INVALID_OPERATION at the draw on Mali).
- Checks: GLInterfaceLayoutsTest (new, CI list: every asset shader's layouts), tools/check_shader_fp16.py (new, CI: no mediump
  operation with a constant outside the fp16 range), every asset shader through glslc as readProgram builds it (68 OK), the film
  shaders bit-exact on the host with highp (film_bitexact), FilmEffectsTest, check_colour_output --gl.
- Open: a Mali phone (X300 Pro / X200 Pro / Pixel 7): the film photo, «ARK AE GPU: stats=gpu» in the log.

### P318 - Quad (2x2) and Tetra (4x4) for every colour filter arrangement (owner, 2026-10-21: «у нас 2x2 4x4 оптимизированы под все цветовые фильтры? Займись оптимизацией/исправлением без агентов, самостоятельно»): DONE (the lead, no agents); the merge and the DNG writer checked on the OPPO X7U, the app not device-tested.
- Question: the native mosaic merge (scam-hybrid.h: canonical coordinates with cfaShift, kHybNatAccess, kHybMergeMosaicFast, the
  P313 NAT_US_PASS fill, the row correction, hybridUsGlobalShift / hybridUltrashortLocal, the Bento / clip flags, the remosaic and
  the merged mosaic DNG) and the app's mosaic paths (LiveRawFrame cell means + rawdevelop cfa_mode 0, LiveArkMeter, MosaicNeutral,
  MosaicBlockDetector, the remosaic) for RGGB, GRBG, GBRG and BGGR phases of the colour blocks.
- Method: the same burst in the four phases (cropped by one colour block on the left / top, CFA index XOR 1 / 2), merged by the
  current worker on the OPPO; each output against the RGGB one shifted by the block - only the borders may differ.
- Tools (SCR p318): nchcrop.cpp (a v10..v12 burst cropped by dx / dy colour blocks, the header's CFA index flipped per block
  parity, an optional block for the synthetic bursts), cmp_cfa.py (per channel median ratio, share of pixels > 2 % apart, the
  part of the difference periodic in 2b px - a CFA mistake leaves a pattern locked to the blocks - and the highlights' chroma /
  level where the reference is >= 0.9). Controls: a shift by 2b (the same phase) shows what the crop alone changes (the
  reference frame's tiles, the alignment, the Bento masks move with the border).
- Merge: every phase as its same-phase control. syn_b2 (Quad): x / y / xy shifts 13.7 / 26.3 / 26.1 % > 2 % against the controls
  13.7 / 26.3 %; syn_b4 (Tetra): 9.5 / 18.3 / 19.0 % against 9.5 / 18.2 %; isz2 (real 2x ISZ Quad, X7U): 1.8 / 1.5 / 2.6 %
  against 2.0 %; v10_2 (real Tetra, BGGR): 0.003 / 0.002 / 0.003 % against 2.7 %. Channel ratios 0.9998..1.0001 in all, no
  block-locked pattern (lattice rms 1e-6..2.5e-4 of a difference rms 3e-5..1.4e-2, at the controls' level), no NaN, the
  highlights' chroma p99 ~0.01 in every phase. The app's mosaic paths take the CFA index per block (MosaicNeutral, the
  LiveRawFrame cell means, the remosaic) and every crop keeps whole colour periods (RawCrop and Wide169 start on multiples of
  8 = 2 x Tetra), so the phase never changes inside the app.
- Found: the DNG writer. (1) dngCreator.cpp setCFAPattern expanded the 2x2 order to 4x4 inside its 4-byte array
  (DngMetadata.cfa_pattern[4]): 12 bytes over cfa_repeat_pattern_dim and the has_* flags after it. With the colour set before the
  CFA (DngCreator.setParameters) a BGGR file lost ForwardMatrix1 and AsShotNeutral and a GBRG file every colour matrix and its
  illuminant (checked against the HEAD writer on the phone: 9 failures in 8 cases, RGGB / GRBG kept them by luck) - most likely P215
  (X200 Ultra tele / X100 Ultra DNGs without AsShotNeutral and ForwardMatrix, the tele and the ISZ modules are BGGR), not a
  non-finite value; a matrix set after the CFA moved the CFA instead. (2) The merged mosaic DNG of P267 (no remosaic: the shot
  is the DNG in the Quad / Tetra layout) and a mosaic stream's reference frame declared a 2x2 Bayer pattern: every raw converter
  (and our DNG preview: the pink thumbnail) developed a Quad / Tetra mosaic as Bayer; the GainMap put each channel's gain on its
  neighbours' sites.
- Fix: cfa_pattern keeps the 2x2 order; DngCreator.setMosaicBlock (JNI; from Parameters.dngMosaicBlock in setParameters, before
  the GainMap) gives the stored mosaic's block: CFARepeatPatternDim 2b x 2b with the order per block (4x4 Quad, 8x8 Tetra: the
  DNG SDK takes up to 8x8; Scam Remosaic's declaredRed reads the block order from either), BlackLevelRepeatDim 2b x 2b when the
  four levels differ (2x2 as before when equal), one GainMap per channel and block site with pitch 2b (16 / 64 maps). ScamProcessor
  sets it around its two DNGs: the merged DNG takes ScamHybridBurst.lastDngMosaic (1 with our remosaic: that DNG is Bayer), the
  reference frame lastStreamBlock (the stream's measured / stored block, whole colour periods only), then 1 again. The writer
  also frees its four gain-map copies (leaked before).
- Also fixed: the CI's unit-test line had GLInterfaceLayoutsTest glued to the next --tests (P317's edit: one argument, the
  next class taken for a Gradle task).
- Checks: tools/check_dng_mosaic_cfa.cpp (new, CI: g++ -fsanitize=address,undefined; NDK clang on the X7U: 51 cases - the four
  orders x blocks 1 / 2 / 4 x equal / unequal black x colour before / after the CFA: CFARepeatPatternDim, CFAPattern, BlackLevel,
  ColorMatrix1, ForwardMatrix1, AsShotNeutral, CalibrationIlluminant1, every GainMap on a site of its own colour, every site once;
  blocks 0 / 3 / 8 give Bayer), CropUpscaleTest (new case: the block reaches the writer before the GainMap, merged / reference
  blocks, the reset), DngMetadataTest, DngPreviewTest (any repeat pattern), DngColourTest.
- Open: a phone DNG of each kind (merged mosaic, reference frame, plain Bayer) in Lightroom and Scam Remosaic; whether the
  owner's X200 Ultra / X100 Ultra DNGs carry AsShotNeutral / ForwardMatrix1 again (P215).

### P321 - DCG frames are not normal RAW: no brackets, linearity proven by the histogram, two noise zones (owner, 2026-10-23: the DCG table «DCG — это НЕ обычный RAW» with its four prohibitions, «с DCG света и тени должны тянуться так же хорошо как с применением сверхкороткого и длинного кадра, т.е. ему по идее они не нужны», «подтверждения мои не нужны, делай и решай всё сам»): DONE in code, not device-tested.
- Audit (scratchpad dcg/r5-r9, map4-map7; report Downloads/x200u/dcg_report_p321.md): the X200 Ultra's camera 3 (imx06c) never runs DCG in
  SCAMERA - its logs show sensor modes 1 / 3 / 4 / 13 only, all bpp 10 with hdrDcgMode 0 (CHI inventory, reports/pd2454-native-main-
  force7-isz-usecase6-observed-20261015.txt:4), white 1023, every saved buffer / DNG max 1023 without gaps; the DCG rows are 5 / 12
  (4096x2304 / 4096x2632, 14-bit sensor fusion) and 9 / 11 (DCG4, 10-bit IMAGE + IMAGE_SHORT pair), none delivered a RAW
  (DEVICE-FRONTIER-20261016.md). SCAMERA's DCG frames come from the «DCG 14 бит» switch (X300 Ultra 17 / 11 / 20, 14-bit under 1023,
  clip 8694; Xiaomi 15 Ultra mode 24) and the Pixel 10 Pro main (owner: DCG in every format). 186 pipeline places classified against
  the 7 assumptions: 68 broke.
- Predicate: Dcg14Mode.frames(c) = PixelPro10.dcgMain(c) (back, 6.9 mm, sensor > 7 mm wide, not FULLRES) || (active(c) && the
  session's levels resolve 14 bit: a HAL that ran its plain mode under the request stays plain), latched at the press (ImageSaver.
  dcgShot -> DefaultSaver -> ScamProcessor -> Parameters.dcgShot); Dcg14Mode.requested(c) (the request) for the session's level
  learning and the settings hint (RawLevels.dcgFrames: the running camera only); the P163 gain floor for the switch's routes only.
- Plan (HybridPlan.build / manualLong, dcg): no Shasta; Bento «Всегда» reads as «Авто» - ultrashort only where the buffered DCG frame
  measurably clips (the X300 Ultra's DCG window clipped, P163); the worker gets "bento 1 / shastaEnable 0 / mochi 0"
  (ScamHybridBurst.DCG_TUNING), bracketed frames of a DCG burst are left out.
- Linearity (RawLinearity, ScamProcessor.dcgLinearity, before the white balance and the merge): votes per colour (greens pooled);
  a knee = R, G and B stepping alike at one code; one colour without the step decides «no knee there»; LINEAR only with no knee and
  >= 85 % of the samples at decided codes (an untested code is no proof); found -> every frame expanded through the inverse PWL in
  place, levels follow; not proven / not checkable / not linearisable -> the frames of another exposure are left out.
- Levels: raw_wide forced in DCG sessions; module level overrides not applied to DCG; widenToSamples takes the measured clip;
  RawPayloadCheck measures the clip of known-depth sessions (15 Ultra) and of DCG streams at the declared depth (Pixel, RawLevels.
  dcgClip); Parameters.dcgIsoScale = range / declared range when the white is a measured clip, on the X300 Ultra only (where the ISO
  1336 for 167 was seen; other routes log it and keep 1).
- Noise: the worker fits var = S m + (m < T ? Oh : Ol) on the noise check's flat blocks (scam-dcg-noise.h, tools/check_dcg_noise.cpp
  in CI), the DCG programs take the zone's offset blended over 0.9 .. 1.1 x T (exact-line replacements in kHybHelpers / kHybMergeCommon /
  kHybMergeMosaicFast / kHybGuide; every non-DCG source byte-identical, kHybMergeMain1 untouched); Sabre key, auto2x and the F6 damping
  take the zones; "HYBRID NOISE CHECK DCG:" -> Parameters.dcgNoise -> ScamDenoise (scamdn DCG_ZONES), finish SNR, dark keep, the WhyAe
  clamp, the DNG NoiseProfile (S, Oh). NoiseModeler evaluates a chosen profile / the fallback at ISO / dcgIsoScale.
- Tone: WhyAe's night factor reads ISO / dcgIsoScale (photo and viewfinder), the «not below the captured exposure» floor holds for DCG,
  WhyFusion's bracket_dn is off for DCG without Bento.
- Settings: while the running camera takes DCG frames, the shadow-frame rows say why they do not act. A DCG shot the merge could

- Ark 1.92 (com.arkcam, libopenhdr_engine.so, no libgcastartup any more): its own GLSL Sabre. The kernel's SNR is Google's key
  0.18 / sqrt(O + 0.18 S) of the base frame and its curves are ours (f2 {1,4,14,30} -> {0.01,0.002,0.001,0.001}, f3 {1,3,12,30} ->
  {0.02,0.015,0.009,0.006}, cov_* defaults = the key-30 values 8.8 / 1.0 / 0.001 / 4.0 / 1.33 / 166.7): the 6.1 kernel is the same.
  Defaults: multiscale denoise off, Sabre denoise factor 0.4 with luma revert 0.85 (motion 0.5), grain 0.15 only where < 5 frames
  merged, no sharpening (USM / bilateral radius 0), 15 frames, no long frames. Rejection = Google's with a binary motion prior
  (flow variation / affine residual: half the noise forgiven, boost); anti-zipper = on the motion fallback a 3x3 directional green +
  chroma damping by the Gr / Gb step, and a 5x5 chroma-difference filter on the highlight mask.
- The owner's ISO 12800 pair: our fine / mid luma noise 0.65 / 0.59 x Ark's, chroma 0.6 x: 23 merged frames (3 long at A = 4)
  against Ark's 15, not a stronger luma denoise (the tiers revert 0.9 / 0.88 there).

  forgiven inside it, the boost by the share), baseDemosaicAlias 1 (Bayer base demosaic: colour difference damped by the Gr / Gb
  step of the 5x5 core above 2 sigma of the phase means, less along a clear edge). Both off by worker default (replays unchanged),
  sent by the app. Kept off (keys only): plainChromaHand (the hand-held share of the plain chroma median: 0.35 doubled the
  synthetic colour error) and shastaSharpLo / Hi (bracketed weight by sharpness: no detail change, the long frames add SNR).
- App: ScamDenoise puts back dn_luma_grain 0.5 of the finest-scale luma noise it removed (scamdn/lgrain: high band of
  Y_in - Y_den, added to Y in the last chroma pass: the colour denoise sees no extra grain), and the colour denoise eases off
  above SNR 20 to dn_chroma_day 0.5 at SNR 80 (ScamDenoiseTables.dayChroma). scam_dev keys hybrid_rej_prior, hybrid_base_demosaic_alias,
  hybrid_plain_chroma_hand, hybrid_dn_luma_grain, hybrid_dn_chroma_day.
