### P342 - the rejection map (owner, 2026-10-26: lab screenshots of our «Реджект» map next to ArkCam's «после · отсечение», «вот так выглядит реджект у нас и у Арк камеры», «займись картой реджектов»): DONE in code, replayed on the OPPO (worker with the owner's tuning, CRE off), not shot on a phone; not pushed («на гит не лей»).
- Cause: kHybReject tested one cell (the donor's bilinear sample against the base cell): a single noise draw. With the noise
  model exact (simulation) the mean weight is 0.94 and 13 % of the cells fall under 0.85; DilateMask sums 25 cells of those tails
  into a rejection of the area. Owner's 18:40 night burst: static sky 0.78 of each frame (raw 0.92, 20 % of the cells < 0.85),
  deck 0.81, dark sea 0.97. Merged noise changed little (-1 %: a uniform weight hardly changes the variance) - the map was wrong,
  the image only slightly.
- Fix (worker rejPool, app sends 1; rejPool 0 bit-identical to before, md5 checked): the distance from the mean over the 3 x 3
  cells of the squared difference (the donor bilinear at each neighbour from the 4 x 4 cells, the base cell from the guide), the
  noise forgiven after the mean; a single cell still rejected by itself above the pooled distance + rejPoolT 0.7 (< 0.7 % of
  noise cells). The difference of the 3 x 3 means (Google's) was tried first: it cancels moving water's ripples (accepted 0.42 ->
  0.52, the waves went soft) - rejected.
- Replay: night sky 0.78 -> 0.95, deck 0.81 -> 0.96, merge factors 0.86 -> 0.96; day 17:57 wall 0.94 -> 0.98, moving sea 0.42 ->
  0.44 (ripples as before). Time unchanged. Synthetic moving-object bursts (replay_synth_burst): moving / border error within
  +-1 %, colour hf -9 % (day).

  two 2 stops (likely two module slots / ISZ crops with the same factor, e.g. UW ISZ x2 = 0.8 next to a main crop 0.8, main ISZ 2x
  next to another 2x entry). The log has no line listing the strip's stops or the slot behind each.

### P345 - gallery / viewer bugs on the X200 Ultra (owner, 2026-10-26: screen recording Screenrecording_20261026_163809.mp4 (10 s), build 5f32a380 CI, «на видео ты ещё видишь баг с галереей»):DONE in code (not yet tried on a phone).
- 0.0-1.5 s: gallery «Галерея» (Все 4524 / Camera 4522 / Raw 2) -> back to the camera: the viewfinder is black ~1.5 s (1.2 s frame) before
  the picture comes back (2.9 s).
- 3.0-5.2 s: the thumbnail opens the viewer (Сегодня 16:36, 35 мм, 13 Мп, JPEG) -> Удалить -> our sheet «Удалить снимок? Файл удалится с
  телефона...» -> Удалить -> then the SYSTEM dialog «Разрешить приложению SCAMERA удалить это фото?» (MediaStore delete request): a double
  confirmation; the system dialog's preview is grey at first (5.9 s), and behind it the viewer has already closed to the camera.
- 6.6-9.5 s: after «Разрешить» the camera viewfinder stays BLACK ~3 s before the picture returns (9.9 s).
- After the delete the bottom-left thumbnail still shows the deleted photo (the dark room shot) at 9.9 s: it is not refreshed to the
  previous photo.
- Fix: one confirmation only (when MediaStore.createDeleteRequest is needed, skip our own sheet or use the system one alone; app-owned
  files can be deleted without the system request); keep the viewer open on the next photo after the delete; refresh the thumbnail to the
  newest remaining photo (or clear it) when its file is gone; find why the camera session restarts black for 1.5-3 s after the gallery /
  the system dialog (onPause/onResume of the camera fragment closing the session? keep it, or show the last frame instead of black) -
  needs a log of the same sequence (SCAMERA-debug.log) to see the session timeline.
- Cause of the closing viewer / lost result / stale thumbnail / 3 s black: GalleryFileOperations.deleteImageFiles starts the system
  delete request with ActivityCompat.startIntentSenderForResult; P299's onUserLeaveHint rule (close the gallery when the user leaves it)
  knew only startActivityForResult as the gallery's own launch, so the system dialog finished the gallery under it (the camera came to
  the front behind the dialog, the result went nowhere). Fix: GalleryActivity.startIntentSenderForResult sets childLaunch too.
- One confirmation: GalleryFileOperations.needsSystemDeleteRequest (Android 11+, any file whose OWNER_PACKAGE_NAME is not this app): then
  the system dialog alone (no «Удалить снимок?» sheet); the app's own photos: the sheet, then ContentResolver.delete without the system
  dialog. Viewer and library fragments both.
- Black viewfinder on the way back: CameraFragment.freezeViewfinder (onPause: PixelCopy of the viewfinder at half size, waits <= 80 ms)
  and showFrozenViewfinder (onResume: an ImageView vfFreeze over the viewfinder until MainRenderer.shownTimestamp moves, or 4 s).
- Evidence: research/handoff/evidence/P345-x200u-gallery-delete-frames.jpg (every changed frame, 0.5 s step) and
  P345-x200u-gallery-delete-key-frames.jpg (1.2 / 2.9 / 5.2 / 5.9 / 6.6 / 7.0 / 7.5 / 9.9 s).

### P349 - the sun a flat disc, dark contours along edges against the glow (owner, 2026-10-26: «у нас солнце как круг выглядит на новой версии, сделай схоже с Арк камерой»; «грани у нас выглядят гораздо хуже чем у Арк камеры», «хорошо видно справа от солнца», «ступеньки у Арк тоже выглядят отлично»; «перепроверь лестницу»): DONE in code, host replay only.
- The disc: the merge holds it as a flat plateau at the data ceiling (8.0, clip flags 55: R, G, B clipped in the ultrashort too)
  inside a 2 - 3 x white glow; the tone kept the glow below white, so the plateau stood out with a hard edge, plus a -4 level
  ring from hr_detail at the clipped edge. A higher em0 ceiling (4 / 8 / none) or a lower tone ceiling (hr 8 / 5) did not
  help (hr 5 / 8: an orange ring). New sun bloom: ScamRgb.sunBloom builds the share of fully clipped pixels ((flags & 7) == 7)
  per block (~192 blocks on the shorter side, scamhdr/suncore.glsl MODE 0) and spreads it by a separable max-gaussian
  (R = 0.033 x the shorter side, MODE 1: max over blocks of exp(-d^2/R^2) x share); WhyCombine (SUN_BLOOM) moves bright
  pixels (display Y 0.55 .. 0.85 gate: the rungs in front of the sun stay dark) towards warm white (1, 0.93, 0.78), white near
  the core, by smoothstep(0.4, 0.9, that share). A core much smaller than a block (the moon here, 285 px; LEDs) gets none;
  recovered windows (no fully clipped core) none. Dev keys hybrid_why_sun_bloom (1) / _radius (0.033).
- The contours: the merge is clean; the detail delta x 1.7 (P340 gain by SNR) overshot every edge the whyLow base has soft (a
  dark line with stair-steps on the dark side: rails / rungs against the sky, the window frame by the sun). Now a gain above
  1 lifts only the small deltas (delta + (g - 1) clamp(delta, +-0.02)); and next to light above white (brightest footprint
  tap, Y x ae 0.8 .. 1.3) the darkening delta stops at the kernel full-resolution floor -0.035 L. Host: water texture -5 %
  (still +21 % over gain 1.0), wall and sky unchanged; at night the black dots inside the ships' lights on the horizon gone.
- Checks: glslc combine (4 define sets) + suncore, check_colour_output (P349 strip), check_why_pyramid, check_highlight_landing,
  check_shader_fp16, unit tests. Not device-tested; the bloom needs the clip flags (hybrid with highlight recovery).

### P344 - rejection maps as clean as ArkCam's, motion still cut (owner, 2026-10-26: «Постарайся максимально насколько можешь улучшить реджект карты»; «Для режима "движения" сделай упор на максимальный захват движения»): DONE (harness + OPPO replays), not shot in the app.
- Worker keys (scam-hybrid.h, all off by default; every shader change behind REJ_OPTS, compiled only when a key is on - the
  edited text alone changed Adreno's rounding): rejPool 2 / 3 (each 3 x 3 cell over its own tolerance; 3: the donor texture
  around its own bilinear sample), rejVarExact (the exact bilinear noise factor), rejMatchBlur (the base blurred as the donor's
  sample), rejPerChannel, rejRelFloor (model-error floor), rejMeanDiff / rejMeanTex / rejMeanFloor (3 x 3 means for smooth motion,
  a gain floor so flicker / AE steps are not motion), rejKneeLo / Hi (dead zone + fall to 0), rejBinLo / Hi, rejClipSym (inert on
  real bursts, keep off), rejNoiseCdm (its forgiveness rescale fixed after review). Shared-memory guide tile: reject +190 ms.
- App (PreferenceKeys, hybrid_rej_set 1): rejPool 3, rejVarExact, rejMatchBlur, rejPerChannel, rejRelFloor 0.004, rejMeanDiff 0.2,
  rejMeanFloor 0.015, rejPoolT 1.2, knee 0.05 / 0.8, dilateFloor 0.35 over the untouched slider default. The tuner's knee 0.1 / 0.6
  cut late hand-held frames on t100546's smooth wall into patches (review): 0.05 / 0.8 halves that (last 4 donors <0.1: r1 8.8 %,
  0.05/0.8 16 %, 0.1/0.6 20.7 %; whole frame cutoff 0.754 / 0.818 / 0.796); no knee at all lost the motion (night water caught
  0.17, lamp ghosts 15.6 %). «Движение»: knee 0.1 / 0.6 + cdm 0.3, no 0.35 floor (harness: night dots caught 0.93 -> 0.97, day
  water 0.60 -> 0.68, ghosts 2.8 -> 2.4 %, static day map 0.976).
- Harness (p342eval, 13 scenes) of the photo set vs rejPool 1: static day robust 0.89 -> 0.99 (cells <0.85 12.8 -> 1.4 %), lamp ghosts
  12 -> 4 %, night water ghosts 16.6 -> 11 %; known trade-off: moving thin wires caught 0.69 -> 0.57 (rejPool 1 also cut static
  wires), water_day ghost 2.5 -> 3.0 %. Real bursts (7): static flat 0.85 - 0.96 -> 0.94 - 0.99; sea / hand still black; isz2 window
  mesh with parallax and a door-bolt specular get more frames (review, small).
- Lab: raw / robust per donor min-pooled over the block (a point sample hid a rejected wire); 'cutoff' («Отсечение», ArkCam's
  view) = min over the NORMAL donors of their block-MEAN robust / A (review: min of minima over 19 - 27 donors drew static scenes as
  speckle, and the long frames' by-design clip zeros drew a static window black); 'accepted' back to the mean weight.
- Checks: keys off bit-identical (b175757 d7b04597..., b184023 2cd8d9cf...), glslc 16 reject / dilate variants (8 without REJ_OPTS ==
  HEAD), check_hybrid_stages / still / series on the OPPO, HybridSettingsTest, ScamLab*. Mali only offline + forced no-tiles path.

### P351 - the gallery's photo editor, Lightroom-mobile basics (owner, 2026-10-26: «нам нужен редактор изображения в галерее с базовыми функциями как в мобильном приложении лайтрума»; «можешь взять за основу для функционала» LightCraft): BUILT, host-tested, not run on a phone.
- Entry: the viewer's «Изменить» opens `gallery/editor/PhotoEditorFragment` (gallery_nav_graph, no new activity, P299 untouched); a
  long press on «Изменить» or the editor's «Открыть в другом приложении» is the old ACTION_EDIT chooser (ExternalEdit, this gallery
  excluded). GalleryActivity also answers ACTION_EDIT image/* (start destination = the editor, RESULT_OK + the copy's URI).
- Tabs: Кадр (Свободный / Оригинал / 1:1 / 4:5 / 3:4 / 4:3 / 16:9 / 9:16, corner / edge handles, drag, pinch, rotate 90, flip,
  Выпрямить +-45 with automatic inset), Стили (8 looks + Сила), Свет (Экспозиция +-4 EV, Контраст, Света, Тени, Белые, Чёрные +
  Кривая: parametric regions with splits and point curves RGB / R / G / B), Цвет (Температура, Оттенок, Сочность, Насыщенность;
  Смешение 8 bands x Тон / Насыщенность / Яркость; Цветокоррекция shadows / midtones / highlights / global + blending / balance;
  Ч/Б with an 8-band mix), Эффекты (Текстура, Чёткость, Дымка, Виньетка + середина, Зерно + размер), Детали (Резкость + радиус,
  Шумоподавление яркости / цвета). Double tap resets a slider; undo / redo (EditHistory, 100 steps); «Сбросить всё», copy / paste of
  settings (crop excluded) in the menu; long press on the picture = «Оригинал»; live RGB histogram (a 160 px readback of the crop,
  at most every 120 ms); back with unsaved edits asks.
- State: `EditState` (sliders by Param, 4 point curves, quarter turns, flip, straighten, crop rect in the turned frame's 0..1,
  ratio) as JSON (defaults left out) in the saved instance state; EditorViewModel keeps the decode, the history and the export
  across rotation.
- GPU (OpenGL ES 3, own context: GLSurfaceView for the preview, EGL pbuffer for the export; shaders in assets/shaders/editor):
  demosaic (RAW, Malvar-He-Cutler) -> nr (5x5 bilateral luma + luma-guided chroma) -> develop (linear light: WB, camera / P3 matrix,
  exposure; log2 Y) -> gauss2 (sharpening + texture blurs) -> main (local tone from guided-filter bases of a 512 px proxy: clarity at
  1 %, shadows / highlights / dehaze at 4 % of the side; tone table; OkLCh colour stage; point curves) -> finish (crop / turn / flip /
  straighten, vignette after the crop, seeded grain on a lattice fixed in crop coordinates). Radii are fractions of the long side
  ("px at 4000"), so the export looks like the preview; crop drags only re-run finish. CPU reference of develop / main in
  EditMath (tests).
- Sources (EditSource): JPEG via BitmapFactory / BitmapRegionDecoder + EXIF orientation; HEIC / WebP / PNG / GIF / AVIF via
  ImageDecoder (preview in linear extended sRGB F16, export in the file's colour space, Display P3 through its matrix; whether the
  platform already turned it is measured against the gallery's Glide thumbnail); DNG via DngRaw (raw data, linearisation, black
  pattern + deltas, white, GainMap, ActiveArea / DefaultCrop, Bayer any phase, Quad -> half-size Bayer, LinearRaw), other RAWs via
  LibRaw (P352); Glide as the fallback. RAW = scene-referred: WB as CCT / Duv from AsShotNeutral through ColorMatrix /
  ForwardMatrix / CameraCalibration interpolated by 1/CCT (DngColor; Температура shows K and «Как снято»), clipped channels to
  neutral, a filmic shoulder with Белые as its white point, BaselineExposure + an automatic lift.
- Export (EditExporter): «Сохранить копию» = new `<name>_edit.jpg` next to the original (MediaStore RELATIVE_PATH, IS_PENDING; DCIM /
  Pictures only, else Pictures/SCAMERA; Android 8 / 9: a file + scan), jpegli q95 4:4:4, EXIF copied (dates, camera, exposure,
  lens, GPS, description) with orientation 1 and the new size; the viewer then opens on the copy. Tiles of 1024 output px, each with
  its source region + EditMath.overlapPx (NR + Gaussian + demosaic reach); one ARGB_8888 output of at most 64 MP (less when free
  memory is short) - 50 MP at full size, 200 MP scaled to the limit with a message; JPEG tiles by BitmapRegionDecoder (a
  power-of-two sample only past 4x the limit), other formats decoded once within the limit, RAW decoded again at full size (2x2
  binned past 64 M samples). Ultra HDR gain maps / HDR renditions are not carried over (SDR sRGB copy); the original is never written.
- LightCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0, used under MIT, commit bb08a697a41b2561a54f1b740245119503b24758): ported - the OkLCh colour stage of
  crates/pipeline/src/colorops.rs (vibrance with skin protection, saturation, 8-band mixer weights / scales, B&W mix, 3-way
  grading weights) and the parametric curve of curve.rs; written here - everything else (local tone, NR, sharpening, dehaze,
  vignette, grain, geometry, tone table, point curves, RAW colour). Notices: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, assets/licenses/LightCraft-MIT.txt.
- Files: gallery/editor/* (EditState, EditHistory, CropMath, EditMath, EditGl, EditRenderer, EditSource, EditExporter, EditorView,
  CropOverlayView, CurveView, EditSlider, EditHistogramView, EditPanels, EditPresets, EditorViewModel, ExternalEdit,
  PhotoEditorFragment), gallery/dng/DngRaw + DngColor (+ DngPreview parses the raw tags), assets/shaders/editor/*, icons
  ui_ic_crop / undo / redo / rotate / detail / effects / styles (tools/make_concept_icons.py), GalleryViewModel.showNewFile,
  ImageViewerFragment (entry, long press, select the copy), GalleryActivity (ACTION_EDIT), manifest.
- Checks: tests EditStateTest 8, CropMathTest 11, EditMathTest 12, DngRawTest 10, RawFormatsTest 4 (+ DngPreviewTest 5 and the
  gallery tests still green); glslc 12 / 12; check_ui_language, check_settings_model PASS; compileDebugJavaWithJavac, assembleDebug.
- Not on a phone yet (needs the owner's CI APK): GL on Adreno / Mali (RGBA16F / RGBA32F targets, R16UI upload), 60 fps while
  dragging, the ImageDecoder orientation probe, HEIC 10-bit / P3 colours vs the viewer, export of 50 / 200 MP (time, memory),
  MediaStore insert into another app's DCIM folder, ACTION_EDIT from another app, RAW colour vs Lightroom on SCAMERA / other DNGs.
- Later: masks, healing / retouch, lens corrections, a 1:1 zoom in the Детали tab, graphical colour wheels, HDR (gain map) export.

### P362 - RawTherapee «Inpaint opposed» for highlights without ultrashort frames (owner, 2026-10-27: «верни для пересветов там, где коротких кадров нет: одиночные кадры, «Движение», сцены, где Bento отказывается»; «считай на гпу»): DONE (host + OPPO), committed locally, not pushed.
- Before: the PhotonCamera port of opposed inpainting went with HighlightRecovery in P129 (a dead field rawClipLevel stayed);
  SHDR recovered every highlight with ScamRgb's per-channel recovery.
- Source: RawTherapee rtengine/hilite_recon.cc, highlight_recovery_opposed (GPL-3 like SCAMERA; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES). RT's
  chrominance sum compares with its tmp buffer, which holds the pixel's own value for an unclipped channel: always 0. Ported
  as darktable does it (the opposed reference at every counted pixel).
- GPU: hlrecovery/opposed (compute, 16 x 16 groups, a 3-pixel halo tile in shared memory, ~9.7 kB): white-balanced values,
  clip 0.987 of the channel's white-balanced clip, masks dilated by RT's pattern (|dx|, |dy| <= 3 without the corners),
  reference = the other two channels' 3x3 means in cube-root space, chrominance per channel from the pixels between clipdark
  (0.03 / 0.125 / 0.03) and the clip; group sums + packed counts to an SSBO, added on the CPU (ScamRgb.opposedMeans); tiles
  without a clipped channel skip it. scamhdr/scamrgb oppU: a clipped channel = max(value, reference + chrominance) on pixels
  without ultrashort content (clip flags bits 4 / 5 clear; without flags only when no ultrashort level), nothing else of the
  SCAM recovery there; plus the never-magenta rule (a clipped G at least min(R, B)): without it the blown lamp cores went
  lavender (G 1.78 vs R / B 1.86).
- Runs only when the clip flags hold such pixels (ScamRgb.opposedPixels on the side thread) or with no ultrashort level at
  all; a lab fragment takes the whole frame's chrominance (LabFrame.oppChroma). scam_dev.txt "hybrid_highlight_opposed 0" =
  the SCAM recovery there as before (DevKeys, post group).
- Checks: tools/check_highlight_opposed.py (in CI): GPU chrominance = numpy reference to 1e-7, reconstruction = reference
  (2e-3), Bento pixels and oppU 0 bit-identical, never lavender, warm lamp keeps R > B; synthetic lamp core error vs truth 0.51
  (SCAM 0.55, none 0.64). check_highlight_neutral / recovery / one_channel_off / signed_rgb PASS, glslc, fp16 check,
  ScamRgbOpposedTest. OPPO (31170 - 31172): the compute pass runs on Adreno 750 (125 -> 56 ms before the skip); on the lamp

    weight is 0 - what the disc would have found (SCAM_BLEND_TILES_OFF = every disc read). Merge 2.23 -> 1.96 s.

  the GPU field on an Adreno (/dev/kgsl-3d0; SCAM_LA_AUTO_CPU = before): merge factors equal on all five bursts (lamp 0.7973,
  b175757 0.7241, x7u_1x 0.9353, isz2 0.8969, led1934 0.6191), PSNR 115 dB against the CPU field, 0.06 - 0.3 s faster on 4 of

  blend 0.23, dilate 0.15, guide / chroma 0.14); post 0.65 s (denoise 0.25-0.3, WHY stats + early sharpen 0.14, ScamRgb 0.13-0.18,

  чем у нас ... сделай так чтобы у нас была скорость такая же, либо быстрее», «для всех делай на ГПУ»).
- Why the reference app is faster (its 2.01 shaders and strings): everything on the GPU in one process - a homography per frame
  from 24 x 24 corners, single-level KLT and RANSAC on compute shaders, a per-frame accumulating merge in fragment shaders on
  textures (3 x 3 Bayer sites through the texture cache), a simpler rejection, the kernel covariance in a texture, zero-copy post.
  Ours had a CPU front end (corner tracker + ultrashort registration + Shasta / Bento checks ~1.1-1.4 s) before the GPU.
- Part 9 (gpuAlign 1, default; 2 = the corner tracker plus the GPU estimate and its distance as a report): the global alignment on

  with a GPU argmin, KLT L1 -> L0, adaptive RANSAC + least squares on the CPU (2 RAW px), two frames in flight; accepted with
  >= 60 inliers and >= 20 % of the tracks, else the corner tracker's fallbacks. F6 residual median 0.06-0.11 px (corner tracker
  0.13-0.33), merge factors equal or higher (led1934 0.619 -> 0.658), crops equal or better.
- Part 10: ultrashort frames first, then bracketed, then normal ones (their F6 field right after the homography, on its gray
  levels); the ultrashort registration skipped after a good homography (>= 100 inliers, rms <= 1.2 px; gpuAlignUsRegister 1
  keeps it); the Shasta motion checks and Bento masks start as soon as their frames are aligned; the GPU F6 field and alignment on
  every GPU (laGpu auto). A GPU failure falls back to the corner tracker for the whole burst (md5 = the old CPU-chroma refs).
- Part 11: the alignment's EGL context and programs made on the worker's warm-up thread while it waits for the burst.
  md5 refs at this point (app tuning + rejSkipUs 1, noiseRoles 1, shastaNoiseWeight 0.005): lamp2324 045ac410, b175757
  bf0595f8, x7u_1x 25f80add, isz2 43a730c1, led1934 b506f059. Shots 31185 (thermal none): total 4.71-4.85 s, merge 3.38-3.46 s.
- Part 12 (seven analyses wrote 26 bit-identical / rounding-level patches; each measured on the OPPO, alternating with HEAD):
  kept - the ultrashort blend's stages 1-3 on GPU-built 16 x 16 tile lists with one program per stage (blend 235 -> 93 ms), the
  cells pass taking a cell's colour from its tile's own quad + no dispatch for donors nothing reads + only the rows the reject and
  merge read, the dilate's accepted weight summed per work group. md5 the same on the five bursts, worker C++ checks 8/8; lamp2324
  replay merge 1896 -> 1730 ms, total 2678 -> 2512 ms (4 alternating runs). Not kept: reject restrict qualifiers / tile indices /
  laCell from the reject / zero exits (slower, or another md5), homography SAD by gathers, fused L0 start + LK, KLT gathers, field
  outputs without copies (alignment 514 -> 514-598 ms: no gain), strip transfers through unsynchronized maps (no gain).

### P365 - the RAW viewfinder with the reference app's requirements (owner, 2026-10-27: «В арк камере тоже есть живой видоискатель, сделай его такимже по требованиям как там»): DONE (OPPO X7U measured)

  (16 HAL buffers), a 1440x1080 ISP stream, noise reduction and edge OFF in the repeating request; ours RAW_SENSOR, 20 images

### P368 - a clip the flags missed is not multiplied into a colour by the white balance and the colour matrix (owner, 2026-10-27, OPPO Find X8 Ultra build 31132, a frosted ceiling bulb: a flat magenta disc with a blue halo in 03-WhyCombine; «У нас нет блока который предотвращает умножение пересветов на коэффициенты CCM»): DONE in code (host + the owner's dump), not shot again on a phone
- Cause: the bulb clipped in every frame, the ultrashort ones included, but their ISO 100 RAW saturates at ~0.90 - 0.95 of the
  white, under the worker's 0.98 thresholds (BENTO usClipped 0, CLIP FLAGS ultrashort=0); the flicker tile field and the gain
  against N moved that clip to 6.0 - 7.1 of k = 8. Camera R, G, B of the core within 3 % and no clip level for ScamRgb: the
  white balance (x1.83 / x1 / x2.39) made it (11.6, 6.5, 15.3), the colour matrix and the highlight landing a magenta disc. The
  halo is real cool light amplified by the matrix (x1.5) and P341's vibrance_hl (x1.6 - 2): left to the colour-matrix work (P370).
- scamrgb.glsl / hlrecovery/chanprep.glsl ceilingShare (uniform usWhiteU = the Bento k, 0 without Bento): camera RGB at one
  common ceiling (min / max 0.65 .. 0.85) above the base frames' white (1.05 .. 1.3 x) goes neutral at its brightest
  white-balanced channel (ceilingGuard, x hlStrength) at every exit of the per-channel recovery; such pixels leave the
  local-light statistics. A neutral stays neutral through the colour matrix (rows normalised), AgX and the landing. Every
  other pixel is bit-identical (no Bento, base-frame data, a measured colour).
- Host: tools/check_highlight_ceiling.py (CI) fails before, passes after; the owner's dump: core chroma 0.197 -> 0.004, rim
  627 -> 7 lavender px of 651. Highlight / colour / LUT checks pass, shader fp16 PASS.
- Known limit: a light whose G alone clips in the ultrashort frames without a flag needs the worker to flag the ultrashort
  frames' own saturation (burst on the phone: Download/SCAMERA/scam_burst-20261027-175141.bin). Phone: the same bulb again.

### P374 - a camera-wide bug audit and its fixes (owner, 2026-10-27: «запусти аудит/агентов по исправлению всех ошибок, багов и неисправностей в камере»; «решай и делай всё сам»): DONE in code (host), not tried on a phone
- Audit: five readers per area, every finding verified adversarially: 46 confirmed + 13 found by the verifiers. Each group
  was fixed on its own branch, reviewed independently and polished; every fix has a test that fails with the fix undone.
- Native worker (worker-cpp-1..5): HybridUsPending waits for its check thread before its state goes (use after free on a
  restart); LaGpuWorker answers its promise on a throw (a lost merge); homCollect's slot order (a frame got another's
  homography / was refused); usRegSkipped instead of a racy string read (TSan); the GPU memory guard counts 18.75 B/px with
  the GPU homography (measured 18.51); frames a failed GPU worker left take the global translation instead of the identity;
  the GPU alignment's thread names its crash stage (a crash there no longer turns the GPU merge off for the session). New
  checks: check_hybrid_us_pending (ASan + TSan), check_la_gpu_errors (-DSCAM_LA_GPU_FAULTS), check_hybrid_gpu_align (TSan,
  a GPU field fault mid-merge). Replay md5 of the 7 control bursts unchanged.
- Gallery / editor (15 + 2): the editor kept on rotation and on Home, the viewer keeps its photo on rotation, VIEW / PICK
  intents open the photo asked for, no double copy on export, leaks of the editor's DNG copies, back from the root library
  after a recreation leaves instead of relaunching, VIEW of video/* no longer claimed (no player), IMAGE_CAPTURE /
  STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA_SECURE entries checked.
- Capture / viewfinder (14 + 2): ETTR on the plain ZSL session (not only with the RAW viewfinder), reset per session and
  camera, held under the Motion mode's ceiling, the 4x-base-ISO ceiling judged on the un-boosted ISO (no oscillation); a
  queued shot keeps its press's rotation, characteristics, camera id and zoom crop (Parameters.camera(), cameraIdAtPress,
  ImageSaver.zoomResidual; FULLRES shots develop with their own session's characteristics, logged under SCAM_CAPTURE); the
  camera reopens after onDisconnected (split screen, a 3 s guard); the frozen viewfinder ends on the first RAW draw and
  ages by elapsedRealtime; latchIsp without an EGL context; the old SurfaceTexture released; the RAW viewfinder's halving
  buffers freed; the horizon stops polling when the window is hidden.

### P369 - our algorithms out of the film simulation's way (owner, 2026-10-27: «Убедись что при включении симуляций плёнки наши алгоритмы не будут мешать симуляциям и в итоге у нас получался "Look" такой какой должен быть с ними»; «решай и делай всё сам»): DONE in code (host), not shot on a phone
- Audit (31 verified findings, the lead's plan A1-A11; owner decisions B1-B14 taken by the lead): the film took our display output
  through a fixed inverse (FilmSim.scene: display white = +5.5 EV, not three stops), so it got +0.3 .. +1.5 EV too much in the mid
  and upper tones and on top our fusion, AgX, macro, vibrance (vibrance_hl), film toe, HL landing, sun bloom, gamma, TONE_OP,
  contrast_boost / ccm_sat; our detail boost, clarity, digital luma grain and «Текстура» stacked on the film's own; the gain map
  undid its highlights; zoom / ISZ / lab fragments sized its grain for the uncropped field; the settings were read live per stage.

  overlay): FilmHalation.from / FilmGrain.from / WhyCombine / the gain map read it, never FilmSim.current() again.
- A2 (the core): why/combine FILM_SIM 1 - the film is fed scene light: the colour source at the luminance of the delta's base
  (whyLow's B-spline on the 2x grid), the full-size detail as the luminance ratio the delta stands for (its P311 / P315 / P349 guards
  kept, before the compression scaling), x ae x deficit x 0.184 / 0.15 (B1: the meter before the overflow cut; the AE grey at the
  film's mid grey), through FilmChain.scene (FilmSim.lutScene: 41^3 per-channel log grid, -10 .. +10 stops around 0.184; the B&W model
  at its own 0.18; the user .cube on the film's print; its own cache) - the print replaces our output (strength 1: outright; below
  it mix(ours, film, s)); under P3_OUT the sRGB print goes to P3 primaries (sRGB transfer). Also the RAW viewfinder (LiveWhyTone:
  FILM_SIM in the point / local / fused passes, the table in the P319 reuse key); the ISP viewfinder, the own-look RAW viewfinder,
  the settings' preview and the tray keep the display chain (B6). FILM_SIM unset: the shader token for token (check_film_sim 1).
  With the film alone (100 %) WhyCombine skips our highlight mask and sun bloom. Film data unreadable: PostPipeline.takeFilm builds
  the table and drops the film from the snapshot (logged), so the whole shot takes the path without a film (our look, the .cube,
  the gain map).
- A3 detail boost x (1 - s); A4 the guided filter's local contrast and the sharpening grain x (1 - s) (USM / bilateral / RL kept);
  A5 the digital luma grain x (1 - s) when the film adds grain; A6 «Текстура» off with a film; B10: any film. A7: the zoom's crop
  read once before the pipeline, Parameters.filmFrameScale (ISZ 4:3 share / zoom crop, set before the lab's snapshot and kept in
  it, so a lab render sizes the effects as the photo had them) and the lab
  fragment's whole-shot size -> FilmHalation.filmLongPx (the effects keep their size in the photo). A8: no gain map with a film
  (SDR file, "HDR off: film simulation"; post_ab follows the same gate). A9: the RAW viewfinder sets vibHlU (P301 parity; changes the
  viewfinder without a film too, not photos), and the P319 tone-reuse key holds the table, so a reused tone redraws once when a
  chosen LUT loads or its strength changes (without a film too). A10: FilmChain.lut builds a chain from its key (FilmSim.Settings.forLut), never from the settings now. A11: the
  preview shows the B&W stocks' grain and softness (FilmEffects.classic, FilmSim.SELWYN / GRAIN_SCALE / grainThrough shared with
  FilmGrain); its note says «примерно».

### P377 - ETTR as light, not gain; the tray's open / close without the parent's fades (owner, 2026-10-28: a video «Исправь анимацию открытия и закрытия подменю … Оно мигает при открытии и закрытии»; «ETTR вообще не работает, разницы никакой нет что в ручных, что в авто»; log c03f8767, X200 Ultra build f118c571): DONE in code (host), not tried on a phone
- Tray: camera_container (and textureHolder) has animateLayoutChanges: its LayoutTransition faded the tray in on VISIBLE (an empty
  plate flashed before TrayMotion's own rise) and out on GONE after TrayMotion's exit (the content went, the empty plate sank, the
  whole tray came back and faded again). TrayMotion.setShown switches the tray's visibility with the parent's four transition types
  off for that one change (on again at once: the rest of the screen keeps its fades); the exit is one fade of the tray (sink,
  shrink, fade) instead of per-child fades followed by the tray's. LutTrayTest.openingAndClosingSkipTheParentsLayoutTransition
  (a LayoutTransition recording showChild / hideChild; fails on the old code with [appear:tray, disappear:tray]).
- ETTR, the owner's log (13:29:43-51, ETTR on, one shot): the AE at 8.333 ms ISO 1883 throughout, the plan N=8.333ms*ISO1883, no
  "ETTR boost" line, only "ETTR held: off" at the end. Causes: (1) the boost was an exposure compensation only - the vivo HAL's AE
  keeps 1/120 s indoors and answers it with gain (no light; the 4x-base-ISO rule meant to stop that read the declared base 1144 of
  the X200 Ultra, so it did not); (2) the tail metered was the 99.9th percentile of the brightest channel: a lamp in the frame
  clipped it and every meter put the boost at 0 (P356's own OPPO note: «indoor lamp scene p99.9 0.997-1.000 -> boost 0 as
  intended»; for this scene not provable - (4)); (3) a hand-set ISO held it entirely; (4) nothing logged the meter's reading.
- DONE: capture/Ettr + CaptureController.ettrMeter + ParamController. The automatic exposure: the AE's own shutter (a settled AE
  frame without a boost, Ettr.learnRef) x 2^boost - at most one ring frame (1e9 / the viewfinder AE range's top: 33.3 ms at [20, 30])
  and the HAL's motion-safe exposure (HalMotion), whole mains half periods where the AE's shutter is one (8333326 ns -> 16.67 / 25 /
  33.3 ms, 10 ms -> 20 / 30 ms), boosts under 0.3 EV not taken - as shutter priority (ParamController.setEttrShutter: the camera's
  priority AE, the Qualcomm vendor priority, else the P82 viewfinder loop, each with its miss fallback), the compensation +boost so
  the AE keeps the ISO; the loop learns its target at the AE's exposure and brightens by the boost after (evStops + ettrEv). A
  clipped tail starts over from the AE (a new reference). With the ISO set by hand: the compensation, which the panel's free shutter
  takes, within one ring frame judged without the boost (Ettr.shutterHeadroomEv; the capture-ettr-oscillation test re-done on it).
  Held (Ettr.hold): the switch, the own native AE, a vivo SDK session, «Движение» (mode or ceiling), a hand-set shutter, the forced
  stabilisation; a hold the owner can change said once on the screen (Lang.t). The tail: the brightest 0.5 % of the quads with the
  ultrashort frames planned (bento != 0), else 0.1 %. Every 2 s while it runs a "ETTR meter:" line (tail, shutter, ISO, AE shutter,
  ceiling, wanted / in force). A new session, the camera closing and the console hiding drop the ETTR shutter (clearEttr / the panel's
  reset; the meter starts over). The stamp: the shot's plan carries " | ETTR +1.0" / " | ETTR ✗ code" (HybridPlan.withNote, the hybrid
  and 50 MP plans), MergeStamp's third line (codes man / mm / nae / sdk / stab / room / clip / hi / band / wait).
- Review round (an independent read of the diff): (1) the viewfinder loop brings the boost late (learn, then 2/3 steps 0.2 s apart):
  metered against the boost asked for, a frame not yet brightened asked for more, overshoot, clip, 0 - pumping; now the auto path
  judges a frame by its own exposure (Ettr.actualEv: shutter x ISO against the AE reference's), the ISO-by-hand path meters only
  once the free shutter held still for ETTR_STILL_FRAMES (12); (2) a tap / the 3A reset / unlockFocus wrote AE on over the loop's
  AE-off request (the compensation alone, as gain): ParamController.ettrLoopOverridden -> the meter starts over; (3) the reference
  goes with a boost dropped to 0 (and with the ISO kept: a scene darker or brighter moves the shutter); (4) a target learned again
  under the boost (the RAW / ISP meter switch) learns with it (loopFresh), not twice; the compensation is set before a longer
  shutter, after a shorter one. Not done: the 50 MP PSL plan's no-plan branch carries no ETTR note (a vivo SDK session holds ETTR).
- Second review round (a workflow: four reviewers, each finding put to a skeptic; 12 found, 7 held): (a) the viewfinder loop at the
  AE's lowest ISO (its start cannot lower the ISO by the boost) or started from frames the compensation had brightened learned the
  boosted brightness as the AE's and added the boost again - clipped, then pumping: ParamController.setEttrShutter takes the AE's
  exposure (Ettr.refProduct) and a new / relearning ETTR loop learns its target with the boost it already holds counted; (b) judged
  by its own exposure, the AE's answer to a darker scene (its ISO) went into the boost and the compensation both (+2, clipped) or a
  brighter one stuck a stop under the target: the frame's own exposure (actualEv) is gone, only settled frames are metered
  (ettrSettled: the AE converged, or the exposure still 12 frames - the loop, the ISO set by hand) and judged against the boost in
  force; (c) a ceiling that came down under the boost (the HAL's motion-safe exposure, the range) is enforced under the minimal step
  too. Tests: the lowest-ISO loop (no second boost), frames on their way with a moving ISO not metered, a darker scene keeps +1, a
  lower ceiling enforced, the range's 60 fps ceiling (16.67 ms: the test no longer passes with a hard-coded 33.3 ms), a moving free
  shutter not metered with the ISO set by hand.
- Tests: EttrTest (the owner's 8.33 ms scene -> 16.67 ms +1 EV, half periods, the ring-frame cap, the shutter headroom without the
  boost and its no-pumping run, the 0.5 % tail past a lamp, the holds), EttrSessionTest (the plain session's shutter priority and the
  AE again when off / closed, one ring frame, the owner's scene and a lamp switched on, the loop brightening by the boost, ISO by hand
  through the compensation, a hand-set shutter held), MergeStampTest.ettrLine.
- Needs a phone: does the X200 Ultra honour the Qualcomm shutter priority (log "priority shutter: the Qualcomm vendor priority

При этом чтобы никто из них не пострадал и результат не ухудшился»): DONE in code (host), not tried on a phone
- Audit: no vendor or SoC gate sends a stage to the CPU. The worker's renderer branches (scam-hybrid.h) chose GPU variants only:
  kHybCells (P364 own-quad fill) vs kHybCellsPlain, the blend's per-stage programs (P364), the blend's GPU-built tile lists (P364),
  the shared-memory reject / dilate (P76 SHARED_TILES); the F6 field is on the GPU everywhere since P364 (auto); the app side's
  RGBA32F upload (P48) is a format choice. Logs: X300 Pro (Mali-G1-Ultra, e8100faa, 15 shots) every merge program compiled and ran,
  «HYBRID LOCAL ALIGN: GPU», «stats=gpu» - the same stages as the X200 Ultra's Adreno 830; the chroma median's CPU / GPU split is
  the shot's (still vs hand-held, P364), not the vendor's. The only Mali CPU path was P376's: the G925 compiler's crash -> the GPU
  merge off -> «cpu-single».
- DONE: kHybCells, the blend's stage programs (named blend0 - blend4 now) and its tile lists on every GPU (tuning cellsPlain 1 /
  blendStages 0 / blendLists 0: the same-result builds). The shared-memory reject / dilate stay Adreno-only: P77's Mali-G57 timings
  with them: dilate +20 %, reject slower - the plain ones are Mali's faster GPU code (no CPU, same result to float rounding, P76).
  A driver death on a same-result variant (ScamHybridBurst.SAME_RESULT_STEPS: «own-quad cells», «blend stage programs», «blend tile
  lists»; the worker marks «GPU merge (blend lists)» around their dispatches) leaves that variant out for good on this build of the
  phone and the app (prefs scam_gpu_learned: Build.FINGERPRINT + versionCode; a system or app update tries again), and the prewarm
  worker learns it before any shot (ScamNeuralClient.prewarmRun: a signal exit -> learnFromPrewarm; its tuning carries what was
  learned): the X200 Pro pays the cells crash once in the background, not a shot's retry at every start.
- Host (llvmpipe = the non-Adreno path): the 7 control bursts and 3 synthetic ultrashort bursts (sbr / sff / sfl: Bento applied,
  the blend's 5 stage programs and lists ran) md5-identical against HEAD (the old Mali path: cellsPlain, one blend program, every
  pixel), the fallback tuning likewise; and the owner's real 26-frame sky burst of P378 (OPPO Find X8 Ultra 4096 x 3072, 20 N + 3
  long + 3 ultrashort, «HYBRID BENTO: applied», blend0 - blend4 compiled) 635a02c2 on both. ScamHybridBurstCrashTest (blend stages / lists steps), ScamHybridLearnedTest (kept for the
  build, another build tries again, a prewarm crash elsewhere is the shot's to learn).
- Review round: a blend-list crash on a driver thread (stage=- last=GPU merge (blend lists): Mali's command threads) is learned
  (crashStage takes that last too), and the worker keeps that mark until the last strip is read back (the driver runs the indirect
  dispatches later); the lab's re-merges carry the same-result lines learned on this phone (ScamLabBurst.burstTuning +
  ScamHybridBurst.sameResultTuning; an X200 Pro burst recorded before would else die on kHybCells in every «now» run).
- Not measured: the Mali speed of the three variants (no Mali here; the Arm offline compiler was downloaded but running it was

  the X300 Pro's - blend0 - blend4 compiled; «hybrid_profile 1» per-pass times before / after on both.

### P386 - a green photo from the 2.4x tele (owner, 2026-10-28, X200 Ultra build 31136, «исправь»: the final JPEG teal / green all over - a brick block of flats teal, the trees yellow-green, the sky pale cyan; diagnostics SCAM-20261028-153831-124-1bbb40b9.zip from Drive 1ZveZz5IoFm-UXwxdkM1tje2L9F2FeroP): DONE in code (host), not tried on a phone
- The zip: camera 5 (the 88 mm tele), ISO 100, 3.4 ms, 20 normal frames, a native mosaic (block 2) merge; colourSource=ISP_CST_PLACEHOLDER
  (the DNG forward matrices are the sRGB -> XYZ placeholder), neutral [0.415, 1, 0.715], the result's CST [1.734 -0.656 -0.078;
  -0.164 1.727 -0.563; 0.109 -0.789 1.680], sceneCct 6870 (the DNG estimate), AWB 5714 K. 02-after-ivst green (no WB: expected);
  03-ScamRgb already teal in the mid tones with a near-neutral sky; 03-WhyCombine teal / yellow-green.
- Root cause (diagnose round, three readers + a fixer + a reviewer): not the colour route - the BLACK. This camera-5 stream (4096x3072
  GRBG, Quad block 2) came without its 64 DN pedestal (true black ~0 - 2 DN: the grey patches' log R/G spread 0.661 at black 24, 0.06
  at 2); Parameters.refineBlackLevel's BlockScan reads plain-Bayer sites - on a block-2 stream all four "channels" land in the green
  quad - so the loss test missed it and the black became the darkest green block's mean, 24.06 DN («data floor (24.0625)»). Red and
  blue lost ~24 DN (71 % of the merged red negative), x2.41 white balance and the CST made the mid tones teal. The CFA phase, the
  neutral (within 2 - 3.5 %) and the CST are right. The native chroma median ran on the over-subtracted data (the shadows' speckle).
- First fix (local branch p386-green): a block-aware scan, the viewfinder's P315 loss test in the photo, the black = the lower of the
  block floor and the smallest non-zero samples; host replay of the owner's shot: grey patches 18 - 30 % chroma -> 2 - 3 %. Review:
  a lost pedestal without deep shade still gives 7 - 40 DN, the samples' floor under-subtracts a partly lost pedestal (magenta), a
  non-zero strip would read as a loss.
- Round 2 (DONE): PedestalMemory - a proven loss and its floor per stream (MosaicStream's key, in memory only: P114's loss went with a
  restart), fed by the photo and by the RAW viewfinder's PedestalFloor (which sees the session's frames before the shot); a frame
  without deep shade takes the stream's floor while its darkest blocks stay under 0.75 x the declared black, a frame back at it
  clears it; the samples' floor only when <= 3 DN (x white / 1023) and >= 3 blocks hold 1/16 of their samples there; whole edge
  block rows / columns all low with a lit line inward are left out. Probe table (true black / old / now / now after a shaded frame of
  the stream): sky + wall lost 0 / 18.8 - 44.5 / 18.7 / 1.0, facade lost 0 / 39.6 - 64 / 39.6 / 1.0, partial read 5: 20 / 19.9 /
  19.9, kept + a 1..4 strip 64 / 64 / 64, drift to 60: 64 everywhere. Replay of the owner's shot: worst grey patch 29.8 % -> 2.4 - 3.8 %.
  Tests ParametersPedestalLossTest, PedestalMemoryTest, ScamProcessorBlackFloorTest, ParametersBlackFloorTest / BlockScanTest,
  PedestalFloorTest. Needs the phone: a camera-5 re-shot (the shadows' colour after a correct merge), whether it always loses the
  pedestal; the single-RAW DNG save still scans as plain Bayer.

### P391 - the WHY pyramid: no halos at edges, continuous depth, shadow lift and fine-band gain bounded by noise (owner, 2026-10-28: «Веса с учётом краёв на каждом уровне ... Глубина пирамиды ... Подъём теней по шуму ... Детали ... делаем»; «Мы будем использовать пирамиду Лапласа, у Арк в последних версиях она как раз и используется, также у него синтетические экспозиции распределены так же как у нас»): DONE in code (host), not tried on a phone
- Measured first (scratch hdr_understand/report_B.md): the literal item 1 (a guided filter on each level's weight map, 30+
  configs) does NOT remove frame / horizon halos (0.033-0.046 against 0.033): their height is made at the finest level by the
  edge's own band, the coarse levels only widen it. Depth sets the width (15 / 29 / 58 / 116 / 232 rows for 3-7 levels), not the
  height. Nothing about ArkCam's pyramid levels is on record; the pyramid and our synthetic exposures stay.
- DONE (item 1, edge-aware bands, lpyr EDGE_BANDS, MODEs 7-10): per level, where the guide's log light differs from its Gaussian 3
  levels down (a step of S EV reads ~S/2; ramp 1.2-1.8 EV, the level's noise taken out in quadrature at 2 sigma), the band is the
  per-pixel fusion's instead of the pyramid's excess; the share spreads up to 3 px (fall 0.25), a coarser level never takes less
  than the finer one around the same place, the coarsest level moves toward the per-pixel fusion by it. Keys hybrid_why_fusion_bands
  (1; 0 = the pyramid as before, bit for bit), _lo / _hi / _reach / _fall / _strength. P349's guided share and P389's edge share
  are off by default with the bands (explicit scam_dev lines bring them back for an A/B); guided() no longer runs by default.
  Host: horizon 0.0321 -> 0.0008 / 0 rows (shipped P349 + P389: 0.0051), window worst zone 0.0707 -> 0.0006 (0.0098), rungs in a
  glow p95 0.0141 -> 0.0008, 2 EV step 0.070 -> 0.0024, twigs no dark fringe (0.5-8 px: -0.0001..0.0000), +-0.5 EV texture 0.97-0.99
  of the pyramid, clouds x0.98-0.99, P310 bar cores 0.797. Kept: 1-1.5 EV edges keep the pyramid's pop (0.032-0.036, about P389's);
  thin dark objects lose the pyramid's own core darkening (their crispness from the detail delta).
- DONE (item 2): continuous depth - levels = ceil(log2(min side / coarse)), the lowest band weighted by the fraction (f = 0 equals
  one level less exactly): 12 MP 4096x3072 5 / 1.0, 4000x3000 5 / 0.966 (was 4), 50 MP 6, 200 MP 7.
- DONE (item 3): the deep floor (P389) capped by the fused luma's noise (closed form, import_why_fusion; FusedCurve / LiveWhyTone
  follow): the one-frame noise model / N_eff^0.8 (the merge map; without it 0.55 x the merged frames), c = 1 measured on the owner's

### P408 - colour matrix and Quad / Tetra white balance as in the reference app (owner, 2026-10-29: «Перенеси логику работы с CCM из
арк, особенно для Quad/Tetra», «логику работы баланса белого с Quad и Tetra перенеси так же с ARK»): DONE
- CcmPresets: the reference's CameraCcmRegistry (94 LMC matrices, ids 4 .. 97, read from its dex). Parameters.ReCalcColor under the
  DCP profile: «Профиль матрицы цвета» (id > 0), else «Своя матрица цвета 3×3» (nine numbers), rows to 1, WB-only sensorToProPhoto;
  routes CCM_PRESET / CCM_OVERRIDE.
- Dynamic CCT (applyDynamicCct): above ISO 400 the rows go to their sums on the diagonal by log16(ISO / 400) x strength (0.6),
  on white matrix x CCM before cct_sat / gains (WhyTone.colourMatrixOf). Off by default as there; we apply it with any matrix
  (the reference only with a registry profile).

  Quad / Tetra» - the live stream's newest result of the last second (its gains, from its neutral point when they are the identity),
  no AWB-state / curve gate; without one the shot's HAL neutral. Not where the ISP runs no 3A (P366's ispIdle): the teacher / P121.
  «Своя оценка SCAMERA» keeps P121 / P212g / P366.
